66:         if (text.isEmpty() || words.isEmpty()) return text
67:         return censorPattern(words).replace(text) { match ->
68:             val word = match.value
69:             if (word.length <= 2) "*".repeat(word.length) else word.take(1) + "*".repeat(word.length - 1)

94:             if (mode == MODE_ROLEPLAY) {

96:                 append("как собеседник в дружеской встрече: можно шутить, спорить, флиртовать ")

 *    звёздочками, смысл ответа не меняется.

10: /**

12:  * голосовых плагинов (`OcrPluginAvailability`, `VoiceRequirement`), чтобы

14:  */

18: 
19:     /** Нужен ключ OpenRouter. Без него Zen всё равно ответит, поэтому это не блокирующее требование. */

22:     /** Нужен GitHub PAT для запуска сессии на ранере. */

24:

26:     RUNNER_ALLOWED,
27: 
28:     /** Нужна скачанная локальная модель из `LocalLlm.CATALOG`. */
29:     MODEL_DOWNLOAD,
30: 
31:     /** Нужна живая сессия ранера. */
32:     RUNNER_SESSION,
33: }
34: 
35: /** Снимок состояния устройства — всё, что нужно для честного статуса бэкенда. */
36: data class AiBackendState(
37:     val networkAvailable: Boolean,
38:     val hasOpenRouterKey: Boolean,
39:     val hasGithubPat: Boolean,
40:     val runnerAllowed: Boolean,
41:     val localModelId: String,
42:     val localModelInstalled: Boolean,
43:     val localModelSizeMb: Int,
44:     val runnerSessionAlive: Boolean,
45: )
46: 
47: /** Итог проверки: готов ли бэкенд и что именно ему мешает. */
48: data class AiBackendStatus(
49:     val available: Boolean,
50:     val missing: List<AiRequirement>,
51:     /** Что сейчас выбрано внутри бэкенда: провайдер, модель, сессия. */
52:     val detail: String,
53: )
54: 
55: /**
56:  * РЕЕСТР БЭКЕНДОВ AI-ЧАТА — «плагины» AI, по образцу `OcrPlugins` и
57:  * `VoicePlugins`.
58:  *
59:  * Ключи совпадают со значениями настройки `pref_ai_backend`, поэтому реестр
60:  * не вводит собственного состояния: что выбрано во вкладке AI, то и здесь.
61:  *
62:  * Второй задачей реестр убирает дублирование маршрутизации: раньше проверка
63:  * «готова ли локальная модель / есть ли живая сессия ранера» была зашита
64:  * прямо в `AiChatTab.send()`. Теперь это `resolve()`, и ровно ту же проверку
65:  * может показать экран настроек, не копируя логику.
66:  */
67: object AiBackends {
68: 
69:     /** Значения `pref_ai_backend`. */
70:     const val BACKEND_ONLINE = "online"
71:     const val BACKEND_LOCAL = "local"
72:     const val BACKEND_RUNNER = "runner"
73: 
74:     /**
75:      * Подпись функции чата, которую ждёт `AiAgent.run(chatFn = …)`.
76:      *
77:      * Это именно `typealias`, а не `fun interface`: `AiAgent.run` принимает
78:      * обычную suspend-функцию, и SAM-преобразование suspend-типов здесь ни к
79:      * чему — с алиасом типы совпадают буквально.
80:      */
81:     typealias ChatFn = suspend (prompt: String, system: String) -> ChatReply?
82: 
83:     /**
84:      * Результат маршрутизации: либо готовая функция чата, либо `message` —
85:      * готовый текст объяснения для пользователя (почему бэкенд не ответил).
86:      */
87:     data class Resolution(
88:         val backendId: String,
89:         val chat: ChatFn?,
90:         val message: String? = null,
91:     ) {
92:         val ready: Boolean get() = chat != null
93:     }
94: 
95:     data class Plugin(
96:         /** Значение настройки `pref_ai_backend`. */
97:         val id: String,
98:         val title: String,
99:         val summary: String,
100:         /** Работает без интернета. */
101:         val offline: Boolean,
102:         /** Требования, без которых бэкенд не ответит. */
103:         val requirements: List<AiRequirement>,
104:         /** Требования-подсказки: их отсутствие не блокирует работу. */
105:         val optionalRequirements: List<AiRequirement> = emptyList(),
106:         /**
107:          * Умеет ли бэкенд работать на конкретной модели — нужно ролям вроде
108:          * оркестратора. У онлайна выбор есть (OpenRouter принимает любой id
109:          * каталога, Zen — из `AiAssistant.ZEN_MODELS`), а локальная модель и
110:          * ранер модель выбирают сами: там роль может выбрать только бэкенд.
111:          */
112:         val supportsModelChoice: Boolean = true,
113:     )
114: 
115:     val ONLINE = Plugin(
116:         id = BACKEND_ONLINE,
117:         title = "Онлайн (Zen / OpenRouter)",
118:         summary = "Бесплатные модели Zen без ключа; при указанном ключе OpenRouter — его модель " +
119:             "и автосмена на Zen при лимите. Инструменты агента исполняет приложение.",
120:         offline = false,
121:         requirements = listOf(AiRequirement.NETWORK),
122:         optionalRequirements = listOf(AiRequirement.OPENROUTER_KEY),
123:     )
124: 
125:     val LOCAL = Plugin(
126:         id = BACKEND_LOCAL,
127:         title = "Локальная LLM",
128:         summary = "Модель на устройстве (LiteRT/.task из LocalLlm.CATALOG). Полностью офлайн, " +
129:             "инструменты агента доступны так же, как и онлайн.",
130:         offline = true,
131:         requirements = listOf(AiRequirement.MODEL_DOWNLOAD),
132:         supportsModelChoice = false,
133:     )
134: 
135:     val RUNNER = Plugin(
136:         id = BACKEND_RUNNER,
137:         title = "Полу-онлайн (GitHub Runner)",
138:         summary = "Модель запускается на GitHub-ранере через llm-runner.yml и отвечает по HTTP. " +
139:             "Нужны PAT и живая сессия.",
140:         offline = false,
141:         requirements = listOf(
142:             AiRequirement.NETWORK,
143:             AiRequirement.GITHUB_PAT,
144:             AiRequirement.RUNNER_ALLOWED,
145:             AiRequirement.RUNNER_SESSION,
146:         ),
147:         supportsModelChoice = false,
148:     )
149: 
150:     val ALL = listOf(ONLINE, LOCAL, RUNNER)
151: 
152:     fun byId(id: String?): Plugin = ALL.firstOrNull { it.id == id } ?: ONLINE
153: 
154:     /**
155:      * Статус бэкенда по снимку состояния. Чистая функция — её можно
156:      * проверять тестами без Android.
157:      *
158:      * @param provider значение `pref_ai_provider` (zen | openrouter) — нужно,
159:      *   чтобы показать фактический онлайн-провайдер в `detail`.
160:      */
161:     fun statusOf(
162:         plugin: Plugin,
163:         state: AiBackendState,
164:         provider: String = AiAssistant.PROVIDER_ZEN,
165:     ): AiBackendStatus {
166:         val missing = mutableListOf<AiRequirement>()
167:         val detail: String
168:         when (plugin.id) {
169:             BACKEND_ONLINE -> {
170:                 if (!state.networkAvailable) missing += AiRequirement.NETWORK
171:                 val openRouter = provider == AiAssistant.PROVIDER_OPENROUTER
172:                 if (openRouter && !state.hasOpenRouterKey) missing += AiRequirement.OPENROUTER_KEY
173:                 detail = if (openRouter && state.hasOpenRouterKey) {
174:                     "Провайдер: OpenRouter, автосмена на Zen при лимите"
175:                 } else {
176:                     "Провайдер: Zen (без ключа)"
177:                 }
178:             }
179: 
180:             BACKEND_LOCAL -> {
181:                 if (!state.localModelInstalled) missing += AiRequirement.MODEL_DOWNLOAD
182:                 detail = when {
183:                     state.localModelId.isBlank() -> "Модель не выбрана"
184:                     state.localModelSizeMb > 0 ->
185:                         "${state.localModelId} • ${state.localModelSizeMb} МБ" +
186:                             if (state.localModelInstalled) " • установлена" else " • не скачана"
187:                     else -> state.localModelId
188:                 }
189:             }
190: 
191:             else -> {
192:                 if (!state.networkAvailable) missing += AiRequirement.NETWORK
193:                 if (!state.hasGithubPat) missing += AiRequirement.GITHUB_PAT
194:                 if (!state.runnerAllowed) missing += AiRequirement.RUNNER_ALLOWED
195:                 if (!state.runnerSessionAlive) missing += AiRequirement.RUNNER_SESSION
196:                 detail = when {
197:                     !state.runnerAllowed -> "Разрешение ранера выключено"
198:                     state.runnerSessionAlive -> "Сессия ранера активна"
199:                     else -> "Нет живой сессии ранера"
200:                 }
201:             }
202:         }
203:         return AiBackendStatus(
204:             available = missing.isEmpty(),
205:             missing = missing.toList(),
206:             detail = detail,
207:         )
208:     }
209: 
210:     /** Читает состояние устройства: настройки + файлы моделей + сессии ранера. */
211:     fun state(context: Context, prefs: OcrPreferences = Injekt.get()): AiBackendState {
212:         val modelId = prefs.localLlmModel().get()
213:         val model = LocalLlm.CATALOG.firstOrNull { it.id == modelId }
214:         val session = liveRunnerSession(context)
215:         return AiBackendState(
216:             // Сеть нужна только для статуса: сам resolve() её не требует,
217:             // потому что онлайн-провайдеры и так отвечают null при сбое.
218:             networkAvailable = isNetworkAvailable(context),
219:             hasOpenRouterKey = prefs.openrouterApiKey().get().isNotBlank(),
220:             hasGithubPat = prefs.githubPat().get().isNotBlank(),
221:             runnerAllowed = prefs.aiAllowRunner().get(),
222:             localModelId = modelId,
223:             localModelInstalled = model != null && runCatching {
224:                 LocalLlm.isInstalled(context, model)
225:             }.getOrDefault(false),
226:             localModelSizeMb = model?.sizeMb ?: 0,
227:             runnerSessionAlive = session?.url != null,
228:         )
229:     }
230: 
231:     /**
232:      * Готов ли бэкенд отвечать и что сказать пользователю, если нет.
233:      *
234:      * Чистая функция (без `Context`), поэтому маршрутизация проверяется
235:      * юнит-тестами, а `resolve()` ниже лишь навешивает на неё реальную
236:      * функцию чата.
237:      */
238:     fun route(backendId: String?, state: AiBackendState): Route {
239:         val plugin = byId(backendId)
240:         return when (plugin.id) {
241:             BACKEND_LOCAL ->
242:                 if (state.localModelId.isNotBlank() && state.localModelInstalled) {
243:                     Route(plugin.id, ready = true)
244:                 } else {
245:                     Route(
246:                         plugin.id,
247:                         ready = false,
248:                         message = "Локальная модель не готова: скачайте её в ⚙ → Локальные LLM и прогоните «Тест»",
249:                     )
250:                 }
251: 
252:             BACKEND_RUNNER ->
253:                 if (state.runnerSessionAlive) {
254:                     Route(plugin.id, ready = true)
255:                 } else {
256:                     Route(
257:                         plugin.id,
258:                         ready = false,
259:                         message = "Нет живой ранер-сессии: запустите её в ⚙ → Полу-онлайн LLM",
260:                     )
261:                 }
262: 
263:             // Онлайн-бэкенд готов всегда: сеть и ключи проверяет сам
264:             // AiAssistant, а при сбое возвращает null — чат показывает это
265:             // пользователю вместо падения.
266:             else -> Route(plugin.id, ready = true)
267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:     /** Вердикт `route()`: какой бэкенд выбран, готов ли он, что сказать. */
271:     data class Route(val backendId: String, val ready: Boolean, val message: String? = null)
272: 
273:     /**
274:      * Выбор бэкенда для запроса. Поведение совпадает с прежней маршрутизацией
275:      * вкладки AI: неизвестное или пустое значение читается как «онлайн»,
276:      * локальная модель и ранер проверяются на готовность, а при неготовности
277:      * возвращается текст объяснения вместо тихого падения.
278:      */
279:     fun resolve(
280:         context: Context,
281:         backendId: String?,
282:         state: AiBackendState = state(context),
283:         maxTokens: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
284:         modelOverride: String? = null,
285:     ): Resolution {
286:         val plugin = byId(backendId)
287:         val route = route(plugin.id, state)
288:         if (!route.ready) {
289:             return Resolution(plugin.id, chat = null, message = route.message)
290:         }
291:         return when (plugin.id) {
292:             BACKEND_LOCAL -> {
293:                 val model = LocalLlm.CATALOG.firstOrNull { it.id == state.localModelId }
294:                 if (model != null && state.localModelInstalled) {
295:                     Resolution(
296:                         backendId = plugin.id,
297:                         chat = { prompt, system ->
298:                             LocalLlm.chat(context, model, "$system\n\n$prompt")
299:                                 ?.let { ChatReply(it, null, model.name) }
300:                         },
301:                     )
302:                 } else {
303:                     Resolution(plugin.id, chat = null, message = route.message)
304:                 }
305:             }
306: 
307:             BACKEND_RUNNER -> {
308: val session = liveRunnerSession(context)
309:                 if (session?.url != null) {
310:                     Resolution(
311:                         backendId = plugin.id,
312:                         chat = { prompt, system ->
313:                             RunnerLlm.chat(context, session, "$system\n\n$prompt")
314:                                 ?.let { ChatReply(it, null, session.model) }
315:                         },
316:                     )
317:                 } else {
318:                     Resolution(plugin.id, chat = null, message = route.message)
319:                 }
320:             }
321: 
322:             else -> Resolution(
323:                 backendId = plugin.id,
324:                 chat = { prompt, system -> AiAssistant.chatFull(prompt, system, maxTokens, modelOverride) },
325:             )
326:         }
327:     }
328: 
329:     /** Столько токенов просил чат вкладки AI до появления реестра. */
330:     const val DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 1800
331: 
332:     /**
333:      * Живая ранер-сессия: URL И непустой apiKey. Сессия без ключа (её могла
334:      * создать hub-ветка, где ключ не пишется в файл) для чата бесполезна —
335:      * `RunnerLlm.chat` возвращает null, поэтому учитывать её как «активную»
336:      * нельзя, иначе UI показывает «сессия активна», а ответов нет.
337:      */
338:     private fun liveRunnerSession(context: Context): RunnerLlm.Session? =
339:         runCatching {
340:             RunnerLlm.listSessions(context).firstOrNull { s ->
341:                 !s.url.isNullOrBlank() && !s.apiKey.isNullOrBlank()
342:             }
343:         }.getOrNull()
344: }

(End of file - total 344 lines)

322:     suspend fun probe(context: Context, m: Model): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
323:         _probeState.value = _probeState.value + (m.id to "testing")

350:         }.onFailure {

353:     }

364:      * Квантованные веса дожимаются на ~20-40%. Файл кладётся в
365:      * workspace AI-агента (/sdcard/Yomikai/AI), откуда его можно
366:      * «Поделиться» в любое приложение.
367:      */
368:     suspend fun exportTarXz(context: Context, m: Model, onProgress: (Float) -> Unit = {}): File? =
369:         withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {

371:             if (!src.isFile) return@withContext null
372:             runCatching {
373:                 val outFile = File(AiWorkspace.root(context), "export/${m.id}.tar.xz")
374:                 outFile.parentFile?.mkdirs()
375:                 val total = src.length().toFloat()
376:                 XZOutputStream(FileOutputStream(outFile), LZMA2Options(6)).use { xz ->
377:                     TarArchiveOutputStream(xz).use { tar ->
378:                         tar.setLongFileMode(TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_POSIX)
379:                         val entry = TarArchiveEntry(src, src.name)
380:                         tar.putArchiveEntry(entry)
381:                         FileInputStream(src).use { input ->
382:                             val buf = ByteArray(1 shl 20)
383:                             var done = 0L
384:                             while (true) {
385:                                 val n = input.read(buf)
386:                                 if (n < 0) break
387:                                 tar.write(buf, 0, n)
388:                                 done += n
389:                                 onProgress(done / total)
390:                             }
391:                         }
392:                         tar.closeArchiveEntry()
393:                     }
394:                 }
395:                 outFile
396:             }.onFailure {
397:                 logcat(LogPriority.ERROR, it) { "LLM export failed" }
398:             }.getOrNull()
399:         }

390:     private fun githubRequest(
391:         token: String,
392:         url: String,
393:         method: String = "GET",
394:         body: String? = null,
395:     ): GithubResponse {
396:         val conn = AiAssistant.openConnection(url) as HttpURLConnection
397:         try {
398:             conn.requestMethod = method
399:             conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
400:             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
401:             conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
402:             conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
403:             conn.setRequestProperty("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
404:             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Yomihon-Runner")
405:             if (body != null) {
406:                 conn.doOutput = true
407:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
408:                 conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toByteArray()) }
409:             }
410:             val code = conn.responseCode
411:             val stream = if (code in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream
412:             return GithubResponse(code, stream?.use { it.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8) }.orEmpty())
413:         } finally {
414:             conn.disconnect()
415:         }
416:     }

418:     /** Скачивание бинарного артефакта с безопасным проходом GitHub redirect. */
419:     private fun githubDownload(token: String, initialUrl: String): BinaryResponse {
420:         var currentUrl = initialUrl
421:         repeat(5) {
422:             val url = URL(currentUrl)
423:             // Redirects ведут на внешнее хранилище артефактов — напрямую, без прокси.
424:             val viaProxy = url.host == "api.github.com"
425:             val conn = if (viaProxy) {
426:                 AiAssistant.openConnection(currentUrl) as HttpURLConnection
427:             } else {
428:                 url.openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
429:             }
430:             try {
431:                 conn.instanceFollowRedirects = false
432:                 conn.connectTimeout = 15_000
433:                 conn.readTimeout = 30_000
434:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
435:                 conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Yomihon-Runner")
436:                 // Не отправляем PAT на внешний release-assets/blob storage.
437:                 if (url.host == "api.github.com") {
438:                     conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
439:                     conn.setRequestProperty("X-GitHub-Api-Version", "2022-11-28")
440:                 }
441:                 val code = conn.responseCode
442:                 if (code in setOf(301, 302, 303, 307, 308)) {
443:                     currentUrl = conn.getHeaderField("Location")
444:                         ?: return BinaryResponse(code, ByteArray(0))
445:                 } else {
446:                     val stream = if (code in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream
447:                     return BinaryResponse(code, stream?.use { it.readBytes() } ?: ByteArray(0))
448:                 }
449:             } finally {
450:                 conn.disconnect()
451:             }
452:         }
453:         return BinaryResponse(310, ByteArray(0))
454:     }

593:     /** Ищет endpoint только внутри нужного run, скачивает zip и читает JSON. */

599:         return runCatching {
600:             val response = githubRequest(

602:                 "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$runId/artifacts?per_page=100",
603:             )
604:             if (response.code !in 200..299) return null
605:             val artifacts = JSONObject(response.body).getJSONArray("artifacts")
606:             var downloadUrl: String? = null
607:             for (i in 0 until artifacts.length()) {
608:                 val artifact = artifacts.getJSONObject(i)
609:                 if (
610:                     artifact.getString("name") == "endpoint-$sessionId" &&
611:                     !artifact.getBoolean("expired")
612:                 ) {

614:                     break

618:             val zipResponse = githubDownload(token, url)
619:             if (zipResponse.code !in 200..299 || zipResponse.body.isEmpty()) return null
620:             var endpointJson: String? = null
621:             ZipInputStream(zipResponse.body.inputStream()).use { zis ->
622:                 var entry = zis.nextEntry

628:                     entry = zis.nextEntry
629:                 }

631:             val endpoint = JSONObject(endpointJson ?: return null)

634:                 endpoint.getString("api_key"),

640:     /** Чат с ранером: OpenAI-совместимый endpoint llama.cpp. */
641:     suspend fun chat(context: Context, session: Session, userText: String): String? =
642:         withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
643:             val url = session.url ?: return@withContext null
644:             val key = session.apiKey ?: return@withContext null
645:             // Запрос строится из КОПИИ истории: мутация session.messages
646:             // происходит только при успешном ответе, поэтому при сбое сети в
647:             // сессию не попадает «фантомная» копия вопроса, а диалог не
648:             // расходится с тем, что реально ушло в ранер.
649:             val messages = JSONArray()
650:             (ArrayList(session.messages) + ("user" to userText)).takeLast(24).forEach { (r, c) ->
651:                 messages.put(JSONObject().put("role", r).put("content", c))
652:             }
653:             val answer = runCatching {
654:                 // Туннель cloudflared тоже может требовать прокси (как chat.try.ai).
655:                 val conn = AiAssistant.openConnection("$url/v1/chat/completions") as HttpURLConnection
656:                 conn.requestMethod = "POST"

658:                 conn.connectTimeout = 20_000
659:                 conn.readTimeout = 180_000
660:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json")
661:                 conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $key")
662:                 val body = JSONObject()
663:                     .put("model", session.model)
664:                     .put("messages", messages)
665:                     .put("max_tokens", 800)
666:                 conn.outputStream.use { it.write(body.toString().toByteArray()) }
667:                 val text = (if (conn.responseCode in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
668:                     ?.use { it.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8) }.orEmpty()
669:                 conn.disconnect()
670:                 JSONObject(text).optJSONArray("choices")?.optJSONObject(0)
671:                     ?.optJSONObject("message")?.optString("content")?.trim()
672:             }.onFailure {
673:                 logcat(LogPriority.WARN, it) { "Runner LLM chat failed" }
674:             }.getOrNull()
675:             if (answer != null) {
676:                 synchronized(session.messages) {
677:                     session.messages += "user" to userText
678:                     session.messages += "assistant" to answer
679:                 }
680:                 saveSession(context, session)
681:             }
682:             answer

739:     /**

741:      * поднимаются opencode serve + oc-gateway (веб/мобильный чат) и npm-hub

749:     suspend fun startOpenCode(

751:         onStatus: (String) -> Unit,
752:         os: String = "linux",
753:         ui: String = "mobile",
754:         branch: String = "opencode-work",
755:     ): Session? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {

759:             return@withContext null
760:         }
761:         val selectedOs = if (os == "windows") "windows" else "linux"
762:         val session = Session(

764:             model = "hub",
765:             os = selectedOs,

768:         onStatus("Отправляем запуск OpenCode в GitHub Actions…")
769:         val dispatchBody = JSONObject()

771:             .put(
772:                 "inputs",
773:                 JSONObject()
774:                     .put("session", session.id)
775:                     .put("os", selectedOs)
776:                     .put("ui", ui)
777:                     .put("branch", branch),
778:             )
779:         val dispatch = runCatching {
780:             githubRequest(
781:                 token = token,
782:                 url = "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/actions/workflows/$WORKFLOW_OPENCODE/dispatches",
783:                 method = "POST",
784:                 body = dispatchBody.toString(),

787:             onStatus("Не удалось связаться с GitHub: ${it.message ?: "ошибка сети"}")
788:             return@withContext null
789:         }
790:         if (dispatch.code !in 200..299) {
791:             onStatus("GitHub отклонил запуск (${dispatch.code}): ${apiError(dispatch.body)}")
792:             return@withContext null
793:         }
794: 
795:         val deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + START_TIMEOUT_MS
796:         var lastStatus = ""
797:         var runId: Long? = null

parts.text:
Now let's look at the `see_page` implementation in ReaderActivity.kt around line 1650-1720 to see how it's registered and what it does — needed for bug (C).

Also for (C), the key question: what makes the model pick `see_page` instead of `web_fetch`? The system prompt has strong "КАРТИНКИ" rules and reader_do emphasis. Let's examine the prompt order and the phrasing.

Key insight for (C):
- `web_fetch` returns TEXT ONLY (no image) — `AiAgent.webFetch` strips HTML and returns text. So it CANNOT "see" a web page's visual design.
- The user says "look at this web page and make something similar" — the agent has NO tool that can render/screenshot a URL. `see_page` is the only "vision" affordance and the system prompt tells the model `see_page` is "это твои глаза" (line 140: "это твои глаза: картинку вижу я, модель описывает её"). Also line 146: "На каждой странице смотри see_page и page_text."
- The prompt also says at line 156: "Правки самой картинки (убрать объект, шум, изменить) инструментов не имеют — умею только смотреть и объяснять словами." — so the model has no way to see the web page design, and its only "look" tool is see_page (the book's page).
- Also line 145-146: "ВАЖНО: чтобы вести читателя постранично, листай сам через turn_page, а не проси прислать скриншоты."
- Additionally, in the ONBOARDING block (line 315-323), when the book session has no rules, the agent is told to do web_search → book_learn etc. And the bookContext includes BookKnowledge.render. 
- Also in `chatOnce` in ReaderAiChatOverlay line 847-856: if the user pastes a link, the prompt says "Прочитай источник через book_learn {"url":"…"}" — pushing the model toward `book_learn` (book's page) rather than web_fetch. And in `AiAgent.SYSTEM_PROMPT` line 124: "@tool book_learn {\"url\":\"https://...\"} — прочитать страницу и сохранить её как источник правил".
- Crucially: `knownToolNames` includes "web_fetch" (line 537), so the parser accepts it. So the tool is implemented and known.

Now let's see: is there any tool that returns an IMAGE from a URL? `see_image` requires a local file in workspace. `gen_image` generates. There's no "fetch image from URL" tool. So for "look at this web page and make something similar" the model literally cannot see the page. The best it can do is web_fetch (text) — but the prompt's "КАРТИНКИ" section teaches "спросить про изображение ... see_image" and the reader_do section says see_page = "это твои глаза". So the model picks see_page (the only vision tool mentioned as "eyes").

@Composable
fun ReaderAiChatOverlay(
    context: Context,
    mangaId: Long?,
    mangaTitle: String,
    chapterTitle: String?,
    onClose: () -> Unit,
    onVoiceGender: String = "female",
    /**
     * Полная остановка по кнопке «Стоп»: прерывает ход агента и всё, что он
     * успел запустить. Без этого кнопка «Стоп» в меню читалки недоступна
     * именно тогда, когда она нужнее всего, — когда открыт чат.
     */
    onStopRequested: () -> Unit = {},
) {
    val history = remember { mutableStateListOf<Msg>() }
    var loading by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var input by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var showClearConfirm by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var attachedName by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var attachedBytes by remember { mutableStateOf<ByteArray?>(null) }
    var activity by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var elapsed by remember { mutableStateOf(0L) }
    var backendLine by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var sessionLine by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    // Как работаем с этой книгой: чат/отыгрыш, 18+, цензура. Заполняется
    // из файла книги и меняется чипами прямо в шапке. Ключ — mangaId, иначе
    // при переходе на другую книгу остались бы настройки предыдущей.
    var bookSettings by remember(mangaId) {
        mutableStateOf(BookKnowledge.profile(context, mangaId))
    }
    // У отыгрыша своя история: канал определяется режимом и объявлен здесь,
    // до лямбды отправки, которая его использует.
    val historyChannel = AiHistoryManager.channelOf(bookSettings.mode)
    // Растёт после каждого ответа: эффект ниже перечитывает сводку сессии.
    var sessionRefresh by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }

    // Вкладка чата: 0 — переписка, 1 — файлы workspace. Читатель искал файлы
    // в чате и в папке телефона: папки на Android 11+ приложение создать не
    // может, поэтому список файлов показываем прямо в чате.
    var tab by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var filesRefresh by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }

    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    // Задача текущего хода: без ссылки её нечем прервать, а прерывать
    // читателю нужно — иначе ответ агента нельзя остановить.
    var runningJob by remember { mutableStateOf<kotlinx.coroutines.Job?>(null) }

    // Сообщение, отправленное «поверх» текущего хода. Раньше поле ввода
    // блокировалось на всё время работы агента, поэтому последовательно
    // спросить его было нельзя в принципе.
    var queuedMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<Pair<String, ByteArray?>?>(null) }

    val showToast: (String) -> Unit = { message -> context.toast(message) }
    val scrollTo: (Int) -> Unit = { index -> scope.launch { listState.animateScrollToItem(index) } }
    val setActivity: (String) -> Unit = { text ->
        scope.launch {
            activity = text
            elapsed = 0L
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        val prefs = uy.kohesive.injekt.Injekt.get<mihon.domain.ocr.service.OcrPreferences>()
        val state = eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiBackends.state(context, prefs)
        val backend = eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiBackends.byId(prefs.aiBackend().get())
        val status = eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiBackends.statusOf(
            backend,
            state,
            prefs.aiProvider().get(),
        )
        val chatTarget = eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiModelRoles.chatTarget(
            chatBackend = prefs.aiBackend().get(),
            chatProvider = prefs.aiProvider().get(),
            chatModel = chatModelLabel(context, prefs),
        )
        val orchestrator = eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiModelRoles.orchestratorTarget(
            chatBackend = prefs.aiBackend().get(),
            chatProvider = prefs.aiProvider().get(),
            chatModel = chatTarget.model,
            orchestratorBackend = prefs.aiOrchestratorBackend().get(),
            orchestratorModel = prefs.aiOrchestratorModel().get(),
            backendState = state,
        )
        val ocrEngine = prefs.ocrModel().get()
        val autoRotate = prefs.aiAutoRotate().get()
        val lines = eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiModelRoles.statusLines(
            eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.ai.AiModelRoles.ocrTarget(
                engineId = ocrEngine.name,
                engineTitle = mihon.data.ocr.OcrPlugins.byModel(ocrEngine).title,
            ),
            chatTarget,
            orchestrator,
        )
        backendLine = if (status.available) {
            // При включённой автосмене отвечать может не та модель, что выбрана,
            // и без подписи это выглядит как «выбрали не ту». Имя ответившей
            // модели показывается в подвале каждого сообщения.
            val rotationNote = if (autoRotate) " · автосмена моделей" else ""
            (lines.joinToString(" · ") + rotationNote).trim()
        } else {
            "${backend.title} · недоступно: ${status.missing.joinToString(", ")}"
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(loading) {
        if (!loading) {
            elapsed = 0L
            activity = ""
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(loading) {
        while (loading) {
            kotlinx.coroutines.delay(1000)
            elapsed += 1
        }
    }

    val send: (String, String?, ByteArray?) -> Unit = { text, fileName, fileBytes ->
        if (text.isNotBlank() && !loading) {
            // Поле очищаем сразу при отправке: оставлять отправленный текст в
            // поле нельзя — читатель видит «не отправлено» и ждёт второй раз.
            input = ""
            sendMessage(
                context = context,
                scope = scope,
                mangaId = mangaId,
                mangaTitle = mangaTitle,
                chapterTitle = chapterTitle,
                input = text,
                attachmentsName = fileName,
                attachmentsBytes = fileBytes,
                history = history,
                loading = { loading = it },
                onScroll = scrollTo,
                censorship = bookSettings.censorship,
                historyChannel = historyChannel,
                onActivity = setActivity,
                onDone = { sessionRefresh += 1 },
            )
            attachedName = null
            attachedBytes = null
        }
    }

    // Отправка, которая не теряет сообщение, поданное во время работы

Now I have the complete picture for (A). Let me carefully re-verify the exact `priorTurns` computation and the timing.

`send` → `sendMessage(...)` with `history` (live SnapshotStateList).
`sendMessage` line 696: `AiHistoryManager.append(context, history, Msg(role="user", text=input), ...)`.
Then line 700-711: `chatOnce(..., history = history, ...)`.

`chatOnce` is `suspend` and called inside `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` at line 804. `history` is the SnapshotStateList. At line 836:
```kotlin
val priorTurns = history
    .dropLast(1)
    .map { it.role to it.text }
    .takeLast(6)
```

So: last 6 messages before the just-added user message = at most 3 full Q/A pairs. 

Wait — is it possible the history list is EMPTY at that point? `AiHistoryManager.append` calls `history.add(msg)` on the SnapshotStateList directly. So no.

Hmm, but there's a subtle issue: `history.add()` inside a coroutine (Dispatchers.IO) not in a snapshot apply... Compose's SnapshotStateList mutation from a background thread — it's applied to the global snapshot, so it works, but reading it back in the same turn is fine.

OK so the effective cap is 6 messages. Plus AiAgent truncates each to 280 chars. Plus `while (budgetedHistory.size > 4 && total > tokenBudget*0.7)` drops oldest while keeping at least 4.

Now the real killer for (A): **the prompt is built from `historyBlock` but the actual user text is at the END of the prompt**, and crucially the history block content is `c.take(280)`. So for typical answers, the model sees at most 3 prior turns truncated to 280 chars. Combined with `onboarding` block and `capabilityBlock` (which is long) — the "Контекст диалога" block is the FIRST thing in the user prompt, and the capability block + system prompt are huge (the SYSTEM_PROMPT is ~8k chars). With maxTokens=1800 output and a small free model (0.5B-3B) context windows, the history gets effectively ignored.

One more check for (A): `AiHistoryManager.append` compression inserts a summary as `role = "ai"`. In `AiAgent.run`, `historyBlock` renders it as "Ассистент: [Сжато: ...]" — the compressed message claims role "ai" even if it was the user's message. Minor mislabeling, but the 6-message window then wastes 1 slot on a 160-char summary. Worth noting.

Also: `Msg.text` for the user turn stored in history is the RAW user input, not the composed `prompt` (with "Книга: ... Вопрос: ..."). Fine.

And the assistant turn stored is `shown` = `maskCensored(reply.text)` — the FINAL text after tool stripping. Good.

Now: is there a case where history is genuinely reset to 0/1 messages? YES — one important one: `AiHistoryManager.load` returns `mutableListOf()` on ANY JSON parse exception (line 95-98) and logs a warning. If the file gets corrupted (e.g. written concurrently by two turns — note `save` is NOT synchronized and `append` mutates then saves; two rapid turns can interleave writes), the whole history silently becomes empty. `historyFile` → `writeText` is not atomic (no temp+rename). With the queued-message feature (sendOrQueue can fire a second turn right after the first) this race is plausible. That's a real "history vanishes" mechanism.

Also `append` is called with the *live* SnapshotStateList; if a stale/compressed entry was inserted, and then `save` does `takeLast(limit)` while the in-memory list has > limit... fine.

Another reset path: `history.clear()` in the composable `LaunchedEffect(mangaId, historyChannel)` (line 296) — if `historyChannel` toggles (e.g. the user flips the Chat/Roleplay chip mid-conversation), the ENTIRE in-memory history is cleared and replaced by the other channel's. That's a concrete "AI chat doesn't remember" trigger! And the previous channel's messages are still in the *other* file, so switching back restores them. Still, the visible history is wiped mid-session.

Yes. Tapping the "Чат"/"Отыгрыш" chip (lines 438-449) mutates mode → channel changes → history cleared & reloaded from the other file. Confirmed.

I have everything I need. Here is the full diagnosis.

---

# AI chat subsystem — diagnosis

Files read in full: `AiAgent.kt` (2051), `AiAssistant.kt` (673), `AiChatTools.kt` (181), `AiReaderTools.kt` (313), `AiHistoryManager.kt` (154), `BookSharedMemory.kt`, `BookChatProfile.kt`, `AiBackends.kt` (344), `LocalLlm.kt` (400), `RunnerLlm.kt` (836), `AiCapabilityReporter.kt`, `AiChatTab.kt` (451), `AiHttpServer.kt`, plus `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt` (the real chat UI — `AiChatTab.kt` is only the OpenCode hub), `ReaderAiActions.kt`, `ReaderBookLookup.kt`, `ZenProtocol.kt`, `AiPlugins.kt`, `AiWorkspaceSurvey.kt`, `ReaderActivity.kt:1620-1769`.

---

## 1. (A) Conversation memory is dropped almost immediately

### 1.1 The exact code that builds the message list — `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:836-839`

```kotlin
val priorTurns = history
    .dropLast(1)
    .map { it.role to it.text }
    .takeLast(6)
```

**This is the primary bug.** The UI holds up to `pref_ai_history_limit` (default **12**, `OcrPreferences.kt:382`) messages, `AiHistoryManager` persists 12, `AiAgent` budgets for 12 — but only the **last 6 messages (≈3 Q/A exchanges)** are ever handed to `AiAgent.run(history = priorTurns)` (`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:869`). The 280-char clip below then truncates each of them.

### 1.2 Second truncation — `AiAgent.kt:296-306`

```kotlin
var budgetedHistory = history
var total = history.sumOf { est(it.second) }
while (budgetedHistory.size > 4 && total > (tokenBudget * 0.7).toInt()) {
    val removed = budgetedHistory.first()
    total -= est(removed.second)
    budgetedHistory = budgetedHistory.drop(1)
}
val trimmedHistory = budgetedHistory
val historyBlock = trimmedHistory.takeLast(historyLimit).joinToString("\n") { (role, c) ->
    (if (role == "user") "Пользователь: " else "Ассистент: ") + c.take(280)
}
```

`c.take(280)` — every turn is cut to 280 characters, mid-sentence. An agent answer that created a file, listed rules, or answered 3 questions is reduced to its first paragraph.

### 1.3 The label lies to the model — `AiAgent.kt:349`

```kotlin
if (historyBlock.isNotBlank()) append("Контекст диалога (последние $historyLimit, бюджет ${tokenBudget} токенов):\n").append(historyBlock).append("\n\n")
```

It announces "последние **12**" while only 6 messages are present. Small models trust the number and behave as if ~6 turns of context exist.

### 1.4 There is no message array at all — memory is a flat text blob

`ZenProtocol.requestBody(...)` (`ZenProtocol.kt:75-120`) builds exactly **one** `user` message:

```kotlin
Family.CHAT -> ... put("messages", JsonArray(listOf(userMessage(userPrompt))))
```

So the whole conversation is squeezed into `userPrompt` as `Пользователь: … / Ассистент: …` lines. The model has no structural turn boundaries, no `role` field, no alternation guarantees.

### 1.5 The history block is buried under ~11.5 KB of prompt

Order in the user prompt (`AiAgent.kt:348-359`): `historyBlock` → `bookContext` → `editionHint` → `sharedMemory` → `onboarding` → `modeBlock` → `attachmentsInfo` → `capabilityBlock` → `userText`.

`SYSTEM_PROMPT` alone is **11,514 characters** of source text (`AiAgent.kt:110-219`). `capabilityBlock` is added **twice** — once to the user prompt (line 356) and again to `systemPromptEffective` (line 374):

```kotlin
val systemPromptEffective = SYSTEM_PROMPT + "\n\n" + workspaceBlock + "\n\n" +
    skillsBlock + "\n\n" + capabilityBlock
```

With ~1.7 KB of history at the very top of a ~15 KB prompt and a free 0.5B–3B model, the recent turns are effectively outside the attention window. This is the "forgets what happened a couple of seconds ago" symptom.

### 1.6 Per-turn history *reset* on mode toggle — `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:295-299`

```kotlin
LaunchedEffect(mangaId, historyChannel) {
    history.clear()
    history.addAll(AiHistoryManager.load(context, mangaId, historyChannel))
    ...
}
```

`historyChannel` is derived from `bookSettings.mode` (line 135). Tapping the **Чат / Отыгрыш** chip (lines 438-449) changes the key → `history.clear()` runs mid-conversation. The visible history is wiped.

### 1.7 Silent total loss on any JSON error + non-atomic save — `AiHistoryManager.kt:86-109`

```kotlin
fun load(...): MutableList<Msg> {
    val f = historyFile(context, mangaId, channel)
    if (!f.exists()) return mutableListOf()
    return try { ... } catch (e: Exception) {
        logcat(LogPriority.WARN, e) { "AiHistoryManager load failed" }
        mutableListOf()          // <-- entire history becomes empty
    }
}
fun save(...) { ... historyFile(...).writeText(json.encodeToString(toSave)) }   // not atomic
```

`save` is unsynchronized non-atomic `writeText`; `append` mutates the shared `SnapshotStateList` and then saves. The queued-message path (`sendOrQueue` → `LaunchedEffect(loading, queuedMessage)`, lines 252-288) can start a second turn immediately after the first; a torn write then makes `load` return an empty list forever.

### 1.8 Compression wastes a slot and mislabels roles — `AiHistoryManager.kt:118-131`

```kotlin
history.add(0, Msg(role = "ai", text = summary, time = System.currentTimeMillis()))
```

The 160-char `[Сжато: …]` blob is tagged `role = "ai"` regardless of the original roles, so `AiAgent.kt:305` renders it as `Ассистент: [Сжато: user: …]` — and it consumes 1 of the 6 slots in the 1.1 window.

### 1.9 The HTTP chat has literally no memory — `AiHttpServer.kt:144`

```kotlin
val reply = runBlocking { AiAgent.run(context, text) }
```

No `history` argument → `history = emptyList()` default (`AiAgent.kt:279`). Every `POST /chat` from the external browser page is a cold start.

### Minimal fix for (A)

```kotlin
// ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:836
val prefs = Injekt.get<mihon.domain.ocr.service.OcrPreferences>()
val keep = prefs.aiHistoryLimit().get().coerceIn(4, 100)
val priorTurns = history
    .dropLast(1)
    .filterNot { it.text.startsWith("[Сжато: ") }   // don't spend a slot on a summary
    .map { it.role to it.text }
    .takeLast(keep)
```
```kotlin
// AiAgent.kt:304
val historyBlock = trimmedHistory.takeLast(historyLimit).joinToString("\n\n") { (role, c) ->
    val tail = if (c.length > 900) "…" + c.takeLast(900) else c   // head+tail, not head-only
    (if (role == "user") "Пользователь" else "Ассистент") + ": $tail"
}
```
Plus: drop `capabilityBlock` from the user prompt (line 356) — it is already in the system prompt; report the real count in the label on line 349; make `save` write to `*.tmp` + `renameTo`.

---

## 2. (B) Tool duration rendered as "0 seconds"

### 2.1 The exact expression — `AiAgent.kt:463-473` (live progress line)

```kotlin
onProgress?.invoke(
    buildString {
        append(finalR.name)
        if (finalR.tookMs > 0) append(" · ").append(finalR.tookMs / 1000).append(" с")
        ...
    },
)
```

### 2.2 And the identical bug in the persisted tool card — `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:747-751`

```kotlin
tools = reply.toolResults.map { tr ->
    buildString {
        append(tr.name)
        if (tr.status == "error") append(" — ошибка")
        if (tr.tookMs > 0) append(" · ").append(tr.tookMs / 1000).append(" с")
```

**Why it rounds to 0:** `tookMs` is in milliseconds; `tookMs / 1000` is integer division. Any tool finishing in **< 1000 ms** prints `0 с`. Fast tools are the majority: `book_recall`, `list_ext`, `provider_list`, `ui_action_list`, `ui_tab_list`, `read_file` (small file), `edit_file`, `book_remember`, `plugin_list`, `skill_list`, `workspace_list`. The guard `tookMs > 0` hides the sub-millisecond case, and `800/1000 == 0` is rendered as an explicit, confident "0 с" — worse than showing nothing.

### 2.3 The measurement itself — `AiAgent.kt:446` and `:457`

```kotlin
val t0 = System.currentTimeMillis()
val r = runCatching {
    withTimeoutOrNull(120_000L) { execute(context, call, chat, mangaId) } ...
}.copy(..., tookMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - t0)
```

Three separate problems:
- **`System.currentTimeMillis()` is wall-clock, not monotonic.** NTP correction or a user changing the clock mid-call yields a negative or bogus duration. `System.nanoTime()` is the correct clock for intervals.
- It times only `execute(...)`, i.e. dispatch + tool body — not the model round-trip. The visible "AI думает · N с" counter is a separate `LaunchedEffect` ticker (`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:216-221`), so the two numbers never agree.
- `AgentReply.tookMs` (`AiAgent.kt:517`) is **computed and never displayed** — `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:743` stores only `tokens`.

Note `check_site` does it right — `AiAgent.kt:1742` prints `${took}мс`.

### Minimal fix

```kotlin
// AiAgent.kt + ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt — shared helper in AiAgent
internal fun humanMs(ms: Long): String =
    if (ms < 1000) "$ms мс" else if (ms < 60_000) "${ms / 1000} с" else "${ms / 60_000} мин ${ms % 60_000 / 1000} с"

// AiAgent.kt:466 and ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:751
if (finalR.tookMs > 0) append(" · ").append(humanMs(finalR.tookMs))
// AiAgent.kt:446 / :457
val t0 = System.nanoTime()
... tookMs = (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1_000_000
```

## 3. (B) "already used N times so it's skipped"

### 3.1 The counter and its scope — `AiAgent.kt:409-442`

```kotlin
val executedCalls = mutableSetOf<String>()        // line 409 — LOCAL to run() = PER TURN
val searchBudget = 3                             // line 415
var searchesUsed = 0                             // line 416
for (round in 1..12) {
    val parsedCalls = parseToolCalls(context, answer)
    if (parsedCalls.isEmpty()) break
    val calls = parsedCalls.filter { call ->
        val fresh = executedCalls.add(call.name + "\u0000" + call.args.toString())
        fresh && (call.name != "web_search" || searchesUsed < searchBudget)
    }
    if (calls.isEmpty() && parsedCalls.any { it.name == "web_search" } &&
        searchesUsed >= searchBudget
    ) {
        answer = stripToolSyntax(context, answer).ifBlank {
            "Поиск в сети уже выполнялся $searchBudget раза и результат использован. " +
                "Дальше искать нечего — отвечаю по тому, что уже есть."
        }
        break
    }
    searchesUsed += calls.count { it.name == "web_search" }
    if (calls.isEmpty()) {
        answer = stripToolSyntax(context, answer).ifBlank {
            "Все запрошенные инструменты уже выполнены; повторный вызов пропущен."
        }
        break
    }
```

`executedCalls` is a function-local `MutableSet` — **per turn**, never per session. It is the *only* tool-call counter in the codebase. **There is no per-tool budget for any tool except `web_search`.**

### 3.2 Why the claim is false, and why it fires "for most tools"

1. **Skipped calls are counted as executed.** `executedCalls.add(...)` runs on line 421 *before* the budget predicate on line 425. A `web_search` rejected by the budget is still recorded as "used". Next round, the same args hit `fresh == false` and are dropped as duplicates even though they never ran.

2. **The dedupe key is the raw JSON string.** `call.args.toString()` is order-sensitive (Android `JSONObject` uses `LinkedHashMap`, so it preserves the order the *model* wrote). `{"query":"x","limit":5}` ≠ `{"limit":5,"query":"x"}`. Small models re-emit calls verbatim, so the exact-match branch fires constantly, and it fires on *legitimate* repeats too: `reader_do {"action":"page_text"}` twice in a turn, `see_page` with the same question, `turn_page {"to":"next"}` twice.

3. **A repeat kills the whole turn.** When `calls.isEmpty()` (line 437) the loop `break`s with the canned *"Все запрошенные инструменты уже выполнены; повторный вызов пропущен."* — no tool name, no reason, and the model never gets to continue. A model that legitimately needs `turn_page` three times is cut off after the first, and the user is told a "repeat was skipped" even though no limit exists.

4. **`parseToolCalls` double-counts every line.** The multiline parser (`AiAgent.kt:582-619`) and the line parser (`AiAgent.kt:622-634`) both match the same `@tool name {json}` line, so one written call yields two identical `ToolCall` objects. The second is silently swallowed by `executedCalls.add` returning `false` — which is what makes a 1-call round look like a "duplicate" round.

5. **The literal "3" is a hard-coded constant, not a count.** Line 431 interpolates `$searchBudget`. The number is right only by coincidence; nothing tells the model the budget exists, and it is per-turn while the agent narrates it as a global limit.

6. `AiWorkspaceSurvey.kt:126` adds a second, unrelated "skipped" message: `"Бюджет чтения исчерпан, не прочитано: …"` (budget `DEFAULT_READ_BUDGET = 12_000`, line 26). Honest, but models conflate it with tool-call limits.

### Minimal fix

```kotlin
// key on a canonical, order-independent signature
fun sig(c: ToolCall): String = c.name + "\u0000" + buildString {
    c.args.keys().asSequence().sorted().forEach { append(it).append('=').append(c.args.opt(it)).append('&') }
}
val calls = parsedCalls.filter { sig(it) !in executedCalls }   // do NOT record rejected calls
executedCalls += calls.map(::sig)
if (calls.isEmpty()) {
    answer = stripToolSyntax(context, answer).ifBlank {
        "Все запрошенные инструменты уже выполнены; повторный вызов пропущен."
    }
    break
}
```
and, instead of `break`, **feed the refusal back to the model** as a tool result so it can continue:
```kotlin
val refusal = "${blocked.name}: лимит вызовов исчерпан (web_search: $searchBudget за ход)"
```
Remove the double-parse in `parseToolCalls` (keep the multiline parser, run the line parser only on lines the multiline parser did not consume).

## 5. (C) "look at this web page and make something similar" → `see_page`

### 5.1 `web_fetch` cannot see anything

`AiAgent.kt:1781-1798`:

```kotlin
private fun webFetch(rawUrl: String, maxChars: Int): String {
    val normalized = if (url.startsWith("http")) url else "https://$url"
    return runCatching {
        val html = fetchText(normalized, maxChars.coerceIn(500, 60_000))
        val text = stripHtml(
            html.replace(Regex("(?is)<script.*?</script>"), " ")
                .replace(Regex("(?is)<style.*?</style>"), " "),
        ).replace(Regex("\\s{2,}"), " ").trim()
        if (text.isBlank()) "$normalized — страница без текста (вероятно, JS-сайт)" else text.take(...)
```

**Params:** `url` (string), `maxChars` (int, default 4000, clamped 500..60000) — `AiAgent.kt:1169-1173`.
**Output:** a plain `String`. Scripts, styles, and every tag are stripped. **No image, no layout, no CSS, no screenshot.** The only "vision" tools in the app are `see_image` (local file only, `AiAgent.kt:1400`) and `reader_do → see_page` (the open book page only, `ReaderActivity.kt:1666`). **There is no tool that renders a URL as an image.**

### 5.2 The system prompt actively steers the model to `see_page`

`AiAgent.kt:135-146` — the `reader_do` block is by far the longest and most emphatic tool description in the 11.5 KB prompt, and it is the only place the word "eyes" appears:

```
"see_page (СПРОСИТЬ ВИЖУЩУЮ МОДЕЛЬ про открытую страницу, обязательно с вопросом: "
"{\"action\":\"see_page\",\"question\":\"что нарисовано на этой странице?\"} — "
"это твои глаза: картинку вижу я, модель описывает её), "
...
"ВАЖНО: чтобы вести читателя постранично, листай сам через turn_page, а не "
"проси прислать скриншоты. На каждой странице смотри see_page и page_text.\n"
```

And the "КАРТИНКИ" block immediately tells the model the *page* is not editable and that it can only "explain in words" — `AiAgent.kt:156`:

```
"Правки самой картинки (убрать объект, шум, изменить) инструментов не имеют — умею только смотреть и объяснять словами.\n"
```

Meanwhile `web_fetch` is one terse line at `AiAgent.kt:121`:
```
"@tool web_fetch {\"url\":\"https://...\",\"maxChars\":4000} — скачать страницу и вернуть её текст без разметки\n"
```

So: the model is told it has exactly one way to "look" (`see_page`, "это твои глаза"), that visual edits are impossible, and that `web_fetch` returns *text*. Given "look at this page and make something similar", `see_page` is the only tool whose name and description match "look at". **The model is behaving correctly given the toolset; the gap is a missing tool.**

### 5.3 The prompt also pushes the model toward the BOOK's page

`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:847-856` — whenever the user pastes a link, the app *itself* instructs `book_learn` (the book's source) rather than `web_fetch`:


And `chatOnce` injects a standing instruction when a book is open (`ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt:859-862`) telling the model to keep calling `book_learn`. So on a fresh session the model is told, three separate times, that the correct response to a URL is `book_learn` → and `book_learn` is a *book* tool (`AiAgent.kt:1220-1252`, it records the URL into the book's knowledge base). 1. Add a real tool — `web_screenshot {"url":…}` that returns PNG bytes into the workspace, then routes them through the existing `askAboutImageFile` vision path (`AiAgent.kt:1978`). Then the model has a truthful way to "look at a page".

Now I can verify the double-parse claim precisely.

Three parsers:
1. XML `<tool_call>` (566-578)
2. Multiline balanced-JSON `markerRe` (582-619)
3. Line-based (622-634)

For a single-line call `@tool see_page {"action":"see_page","question":"x"}`:

Parser 2 (multiline): `markerRe` = `(?:@tool\s+|@)([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s*`. It matches `@tool see_page ` with name=`see_page`. start = indexOf('{', after) = the `{`. depth walk finds balanced end. `end > start` → adds ToolCall. ✓

Parser 3 (lines): line = `@tool see_page {"action":...}`. t = `@tool see_page {...}` → removePrefix("@tool ") → `see_page {...}`. space index → name = `see_page` ✓. json = `{"action":...}` → JSONObject parses ✓ → adds ToolCall. ✗ DUPLICATE

So yes, confirmed: for any single-line complete call, BOTH parser 2 and parser 3 emit a ToolCall. Parser 3's own comment at line 633 says "incomplete JSON is recovered by the multiline parser" — meaning the author intended parser 3 to be a fallback for cases parser 2 misses, but there's NO dedup/guard. Parser 2 handles everything parser 3 handles (parser 2 is strictly more general: it does balanced-brace scanning which also matches single-line calls). So parser 3 is 100% redundant for valid calls, and pure duplication.

Consequence in the run loop: `parsedCalls` = [see_page, see_page] (identical). `executedCalls.add(sig)` → first returns true, second returns false. So the second is filtered out by `fresh`. Net effect: tool runs once, correct behavior. BUT it does inflate `parsedCalls.size`, and more importantly:

The `calls.isEmpty()` check — suppose the model makes ONLY duplicate calls in round 2. Then `parsedCalls` is non-empty, `calls` is empty. If the duplicate is `web_search` and `searchesUsed >= 3` → the "Поиск в сети уже выполнялся 3 раза" message. If it's any other tool → "Все запрошенные инструменты уже выполнены; повторный вызов пропущен."

So the duplicate parsing makes a *legitimately repeated* call look like a round with two calls where one is a dup. But the real trigger for the canned message is the genuine repeat.

More important subtlety I should correct/strengthen: does the duplication actually cause a *skipped* call in a real scenario? Consider the model emitting a call in round 1 and then the same call again in round 2 (a new `answer` string). `executedCalls` persists across rounds within `run()`, so round 2's call is a genuine repeat → filtered → `calls.isEmpty()` → break with canned message. The parser duplication is not the cause; it's an aggravating factor for the *count* seen. My report said it "is what makes a 1-call round look like a 'duplicate' round" — that's accurate in the sense that `parsedCalls` has 2 entries, but `calls` has 1, so no behavior change. Let me be precise: it doesn't change `calls` outcome in round 1. It DOES matter for a case where the model emits the SAME call twice on the same line/block intentionally (e.g. two `page_text` calls with same args in one message) — then parser 2 yields 2, parser 3 yields 2 → 4 entries, only 1 executes. That's arguably desirable dedup, but it's accidental.

Hmm, but there's a subtle REAL bug: if the model emits the same tool with the same args twice deliberately and expects two executions (e.g., `turn_page` next, `turn_page` prev — different args, fine; or `read_file` twice — same result anyway), dedup is fine. So the duplication is mostly benign but wasteful and inflates `parsedCalls` used in the `parsedCalls.any { it.name == "web_search" }` check.

Actually wait — there IS a real consequence. `searchesUsed += calls.count { it.name == "web_search" }`. `calls` is deduped, so no double count. Fine.

But: `onProgress?.invoke("Инструменты: ${calls.joinToString(", ") { it.name }}")` — deduped, fine.

# (A) Conversation memory is lost within seconds

## A1 — The history window is hard-coded to 6 messages (root cause)

**File:** `/home/runner/hub-work/yomikai/code/app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/presentation/reader/components/ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt`
**Lines 836-839** (inside `chatOnce`, `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`, passed to `AiAgent.run(history = priorTurns)` at line 869):

```kotlin
val priorTurns = history
    .dropLast(1)
    .map { it.role to it.text }
    .takeLast(6)
```

**Why wrong:** the UI keeps and persists up to `pref_ai_history_limit` (default **12**), `AiAgent` budgets for `historyLimit` (default 12), and the label in the prompt advertises 12 — but only **6 messages (≈3 exchanges)** ever reach the model. Everything older is silently discarded. Two or three questions in, the first topic is gone.

**Minimal replacement:**

```kotlin
val prefs = Injekt.get<mihon.domain.ocr.service.OcrPreferences>()
val keep = prefs.aiHistoryLimit().get().coerceIn(4, 100)
val priorTurns = history
    .dropLast(1)
    .filterNot { it.text.startsWith("[Сжато: ") }   // не тратим окно на сводку
    .map { it.role to it.text }
    .takeLast(keep)
```

# (B) False "already used 3 times, so it was skipped"

## B5 — The only counter is per-turn, hard-coded, and `web_search`-only

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiAgent.kt` — **lines 409-442**

```kotlin
val executedCalls = mutableSetOf<String>()        // 409 — локально в run() = НА ХОД
val searchBudget = 3                             // 415
var searchesUsed = 0                             // 416
for (round in 1..12) {
    val parsedCalls = parseToolCalls(context, answer)
    if (parsedCalls.isEmpty()) break
    val calls = parsedCalls.filter { call ->
        val fresh = executedCalls.add(call.name + "\u0000" + call.args.toString())
        fresh && (call.name != "web_search" || searchesUsed < searchBudget)
    }
    if (calls.isEmpty() && parsedCalls.any { it.name == "web_search" } &&
        searchesUsed >= searchBudget
    ) {
        answer = stripToolSyntax(context, answer).ifBlank {
            "Поиск в сети уже выполнялся $searchBudget раза и результат использован. " +
                "Дальше искать нечего — отвечаю по тому, что уже есть."
        }
        break
    }
    searchesUsed += calls.count { it.name == "web_search" }
    if (calls.isEmpty()) {
        answer = stripToolSyntax(context, answer).ifBlank {
            "Все запрошенные инструменты уже выполнены; повторный вызов пропущен."
        }
        break
    }
```

**Why wrong — five distinct defects:**

1. **Skipped calls are recorded as executed.** `executedCalls.add(...)` runs on line 421, *before* the budget predicate on line 425. A `web_search` rejected by the budget is still in the set, so on the next round the same args hit `fresh == false` and are dropped as *duplicates* — reported as a repeat when in fact it never ran. This is the direct source of "уже использовано, пропущено" for a tool that has no limit at all.
2. **The dedupe key is order-sensitive raw JSON.** `call.args.toString()` on an Android `JSONObject` (backed by `LinkedHashMap`) preserves the order the *model* wrote. `{"query":"x","limit":5}` ≠ `{"limit":5,"query":"x"}`. So the "duplicate" branch fires on trivially-different spellings, and misses genuine repeats.
3. **A repeat kills the entire turn.** On `calls.isEmpty()` the loop `break`s with the canned string, names no tool, gives no reason, and the model never gets a chance to continue. A model that legitimately needs `turn_page` three times is cut off after the first, and the reader is told a "repeat was skipped" even though **no per-tool limit exists for `turn_page`, `read_file`, `page_text`, or anything else**.
4. **The number 3 is a constant, not a count.** Line 431 interpolates `$searchBudget`. It is correct only by coincidence, it is per-*turn* while the agent narrates it as a global limit, and nothing in the prompt tells the model the budget exists.
5. **Scope is per turn, not per session.** `executedCalls` is a function-local `MutableSet` recreated on every `run()`. A tool called in turn 1 may be called again freely in turn 2 — so "3 times" is not even a session count.

**Minimal replacement:**

```kotlin
fun sig(c: ToolCall): String = buildString {
    append(c.name).append('\u0000')
    c.args.keys().asSequence().sorted().forEach { append(it).append('=').append(c.args.opt(it)).append('&') }
}
val calls = parsedCalls.filter { sig(it) !in executedCalls }   // НЕ пишем отклонённые
executedCalls += calls.map(::sig)                            // пишем только исполненные
if (calls.isEmpty()) {
    val why = parsedCalls.joinToString(", ") { "${it.name}: повтор или лимит" }
    answer = stripToolSyntax(context, answer).ifBlank {
        "Инструменты не выполнены ($why). Повторы за ход запрещены, лимит web_search — $searchBudget."
    }
    break
}
```

And instead of silently ending the turn, feed the refusal back as a tool result so the model continues:

```kotlin
val refusal = "ОТКАЗ: ${blocked.name} — ${if (blocked.name == "web_search") "лимит $searchBudget за ход" else "повтор за ход"}"
```

```kotlin
private fun readUriFile(context: Context, uri: Uri): Pair<String, ByteArray>? =
    runCatching {
        val name = context.contentResolver.query(uri, null, null, null, null)?.use { c ->
            val i = c.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
            if (i >= 0) c.getString(i) else null

        name to bytes
    }.getOrNull()
```


Declared in `overlay-reader/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`: `MainActivity` is the `MAIN`/`LAUNCHER` activity (`launchMode="singleTask"`), and `OverlayReaderService` is a `foregroundServiceType="mediaProjection"` service.

**What could break — briefly:**

- **It is a completely separate Gradle build.** `overlay-reader/settings.gradle.kts:17` declares `rootProject.name = "overlay-reader"`, and the module appears in **no** other `settings.gradle.kts`/`build.gradle` in the repo. `gradle :overlay-reader:…` from the root will not work.
- **It shares no code.** Verified: `grep -rn "^import eu.kanade\|^import mihon\|^import tachiyomi" overlay-reader/` returns **nothing**. It is built on the bare Android framework ("Собран на чистом Android Framework (без androidx)"), with its own `ocr/OcrEngine.kt`, `LocalOcrEngine.kt`, `GlensOcrEngine.kt`, `OcrManager.kt`, and `tts/ReaderTts.kt`.
- **Consequence: every fix in sections (A)-(D) and (F) is compile-safe for it.** There is no import edge to break. The risk is behavioural, not structural:
  1. **Protocol drift.** It has its own `ocr/ProtoCodec.kt` and tests `overlay-reader/app/src/test/java/com/yomikai/overlayreader/ocr/ProtoCodecTest.kt`. Any change to the OCR bridge wire format in `domain/…/ocr/` must be mirrored by hand — nothing enforces it.
  2. **Duplicated OCR/TTS logic.** Its engines and `ReaderTts` will drift from `OcrRepositoryImpl` / `ReaderTts`. A fix to the app's TTS or OCR will *not* reach the overlay.
  3. **Touching the manifest.** The app manifest (`app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml:272-280`, the FileProvider) and `provider_paths.xml` are shared conceptually but not by file; a `files-path` change for AI-workspace has no effect here.
  4. **Tests.** Only `OcrEnginesTest.kt` and `ProtoCodecTest.kt` exist there, and they require a device/emulator for OCR — a `gradle test` at the root will not run them.

**Recommendation:** leave `overlay-reader/` untouched. If the AI/OCR/TTS refactor must reach it, do it by copying the logic deliberately and bumping `ProtoCodec` in lockstep — there is no shared module to carry the change.

# (G) Stub / placeholder audit — "заглушить заглушки"

## G1 — The whole `local` LLM backend is a stub that reports itself as ready

**File:** `.../data/ai/LocalLlm.kt` — **lines 304-353**

```kotlin
private suspend fun ensureEngine(context: Context, m: Model): AutoCloseable? = mutex.withLock {
    ...
    // v1.9.37: MediaPipe GenAI-движок удалён из сборки (−26.6 МБ APK,
    // гейт «APK меньше 60 МБ»). Локальные .task-модели на устройстве не
    // запускаются; файлы моделей остаются для экспорта и полу-онлайн ранеров.
    logcat(LogPriority.WARN) { "LLM engine removed from build (size gate): ${m.id}" }
    null
}

suspend fun probe(context: Context, m: Model): Pair<Boolean, String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
    ... runCatching<String> {
        error("Локальный LLM-движок удалён из сборки для уменьшения размера APK")
    } ...
}

suspend fun chat(context: Context, m: Model, prompt: String): String? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
    ... runCatching<String> {
        error("Локальный LLM-движок удалён из сборки для уменьшения размера APK")
    }.getOrNull()
}
```

**Three separate lies, all verified:**

1. **`LocalLlm.probe` has ZERO call sites.** Verified:
   ```
   $ grep -rn "LocalLlm.probe\|\.probe(" --include=*.kt app/src/main/java/
   (no output)
   ```
   The `error(...)` inside `probe` (line 331) is unreachable dead code. There is no "Тест" for local LLM at all.
2. **Readiness never probes anything.** `.../data/ai/AiBackends.kt` — **lines 223-225**:
   ```kotlin
   localModelInstalled = model != null && runCatching {
       LocalLlm.isInstalled(context, model)
   }.getOrDefault(false),
   ```
   and **lines 241-250**:
   ```kotlin
   BACKEND_LOCAL ->
       if (state.localModelId.isNotBlank() && state.localModelInstalled) {
           Route(plugin.id, ready = true)
       } else {
           Route(plugin.id, ready = false,
               message = "Локальная модель не готова: скачайте её в ⚙ → Локальные LLM и прогоните «Тест»")
       }
   ```
   Readiness is **file presence only**. The not-ready message also tells the user to run a "Тест" that does not exist (item 1).
3. **The capability block actively tells the model the backend works.** `.../data/ai/AiCapabilityReporter.kt` — **line 69**:
   ```kotlin
   Capability("Локальная LLM (.task в /sdcard/Yomikai/models)", FileProbe.hasLocalLlm(context), if (!FileProbe.hasLocalLlm(context)) "Нет .task модели" else "OK"),
   ```
   and **line 72**:
   ```kotlin
   "local" -> if (FileProbe.hasLocalLlm(context)) "OK" else "Нет модели",
   ```
   Rendered into the prompt as `✅ Локальная LLM: доступно` — **and injected twice per turn** (see G4). So a user with a `.task` file selects "Локальная", the prompt says ✅, and every turn then throws from `LocalLlm.chat:349`, surfacing as `AiBackends.kt:298` returning `null` → 3 retries → *"Нет ответа от AI-бененда после повторов и ротации. … Проверьте прокси в ⚙"*, advice for a problem the user cannot fix.

**Minimal replacement (3 parts, all three needed):**

```kotlin
// AiBackends.kt:241-250
BACKEND_LOCAL -> Route(
    plugin.id,
    ready = false,
    message = "Локальный LLM отключён в этой сборке (движок не включён). " +
              "Используйте Онлайн или Полу-онлайн. Файлы .task остаются для экспорта на ранер.",
)
```

```kotlin
// AiCapabilityReporter.kt:69 and :72 — report unavailable, not "OK"
Capability("Локальная LLM (.task в /sdcard/Yomikai/models)", false,
    "Движок не в сборке — только Онлайн/Полу-онлайн"),
```

```kotlin
// LocalLlm.kt — delete the dead probe; keep download/export, re-label them
// (delete lines 322-333; LocalLlm.download / exportTarXz still work)
```

## G2 — `gen_video` and `runner_start` are structurally impossible

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiAgent.kt` — **lines 449-452**

```kotlin
// Инструменты больше не могут зависнуть навсегда (gen_image /
// check_site на медленной сети): жёсткий таймаут 120 секунд.
val r = runCatching {
    withTimeoutOrNull(120_000L) { execute(context, call, chat, mangaId) }
```

vs `.../data/ai/RunnerLlm.kt` — **line 317**: `private const val VIDEO_TIMEOUT_MS = 9L * 60_000L` and **line 371**: `private const val START_TIMEOUT_MS = 12L * 60_000L`.

`gen_image` additionally sets `readTimeout = 120_000` (`AiAgent.kt:1704`), racing the identical 120 s wrapper.

**Minimal replacement:**

```kotlin
private val TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS = mapOf(
    "gen_video" to 10L * 60_000L,
    "runner_start" to 13L * 60_000L,
    "gen_image" to 180_000L,
    "check_site" to 90_000L,
)
val limit = TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS[call.name] ?: 120_000L
val r = runCatching {
    withTimeoutOrNull(limit) { execute(context, call, chat, mangaId) }
        ?: ToolResult(call.name, "ОШИБКА: инструмент не ответил за ${limit / 1000} с", status = "error")
```

## G3 — `gen_video` progress is never wired

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiAgent.kt` — **lines 800-806**

```kotlin
AiChatTools.renderVideo(
    context,
    images,
    call.args.optString("text"),
    call.args.optInt("fps", 3),
    call.args.optString("name").ifBlank { null },
)
```

**Why wrong:** `AiChatTools.renderVideo(context, images, text, fps, nameHint, onStatus = {})` (`AiChatTools.kt:139-145`) accepts an `onStatus` callback that is **not passed**, so a 9-minute job produces zero feedback — the reader sees a frozen "AI думает".

**Minimal replacement:** add `onStatus = { onProgress?.invoke("Видео: $it") },` as the 6th argument (and move the call out of `Dispatchers.IO` if `renderVideo` is not already main-safe — verify before wiring).

## G4 — `capabilityBlock` is injected twice per turn

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiAgent.kt` — computed at **line 307**, injected at **line 356** (user prompt) and **line 374** (system prompt)

```kotlin
val capabilityBlock = runCatching { AiCapabilityReporter.renderForPrompt(context) }.getOrNull().orEmpty()   // 307
...
if (capabilityBlock.isNotBlank()) append(capabilityBlock).append("\n\n")                                    // 356
...
val systemPromptEffective = SYSTEM_PROMPT + "\n\n" + workspaceBlock + "\n\n" +
    skillsBlock + "\n\n" + capabilityBlock                                                                   // 374
```

**Why wrong:** pure duplication, and it makes the G1 lie twice as prominent. **Minimal replacement:** delete line 356 — the system prompt is the correct home for a capability block.

## G5 — Duplicated comment (copy-paste leftover)

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiAgent.kt` — **lines 289-290**

```kotlin
// Продвинутый лимит истории и токен-бюджет (запрос: не тратить 50к токенов)
// Продвинутый лимит истории и токен-бюджет (запрос: не тратить 50к токенов)
```

**Replacement:** keep one line.

## G6 — Runner backend double-counts history and stores the system prompt as a user message

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiBackends.kt` — **lines 307-316**

```kotlin
            BACKEND_RUNNER -> {
val session = liveRunnerSession(context)
                ...
                            RunnerLlm.chat(context, session, "$system\n\n$prompt")
```

(`LocalLlm` does the same at line 298.) `RunnerLlm.chat` (`RunnerLlm.kt:641-683`) appends that **entire blob** to `session.messages` and re-sends `takeLast(24)` on every call — including every tool round inside `AiAgent`.

**Why wrong:** with an 11.5 KB system prompt, that is ~15 KB × 24 ≈ **360 KB** of history pushed at llama.cpp, *on top of* `AiAgent`'s own `historyBlock`. Context explodes, latency and failures follow. Also the system prompt is mislabelled as a user turn, which degrades instruction-following.

**Minimal replacement:** send the system prompt as a real `system` message and keep `session.messages` for user/assistant only:

```kotlin
chat = { prompt, system -> RunnerLlm.chat(context, session, prompt, system) }
// RunnerLlm: build messages = [system] + session.messages + [user(prompt)]
```

## G7 — `AiWorkspaceSurvey.kt:107` contradicts `read_file`

**File:** `.../data/ai/AiWorkspaceSurvey.kt` — **line 107**

```kotlin
sb.append("— $name: изображение ${f.length() / 1024} КБ, я не вижу картинки, опиши словами или используй другое изображение\n")
```

**Why wrong:** `read_file` **does** ask the vision model about images (`AiAgent.kt:1368-1387`). One tool tells the model "I can't see images", another says "I can". Small models believe whichever they saw last.

**Minimal replacement:** delegate to the vision path, or at least stop lying:

```kotlin
if (f.extension.lowercase() in IMAGE_EXT) {
    sb.append("— $name: изображение ${f.length() / 1024} КБ; прочитать его можно see_image " +
              "{\"name\":\"$name\",\"question\":\"…\"} или read_file\n")
    continue
}
```

**Replacement:** delete these three lines and the `import org.json.JSONArray` at line 19.


**Replacement:** indent to 16 spaces. Cosmetic, but it hides the block boundary in review.

See F6. **Replacement:** append the missing names, or drop plugin creation as a shadowing feature.

|---|---|---|---|---|
1 | Duration formatting + `nanoTime()` + populate `AgentReply.tookMs` | B1-B3 | `AiAgent.kt`, `ReaderAiChatOverlay.kt` | ~15 L |

package mihon.domain.ocr.model

/**
 * Represents the available OCR and AI vision models.
 */
enum class OcrModel {
    /**
     * Default downloadable Russian/Cyrillic offline engine: PP-OCRv3 with
     * PP-OCRv5 verifier and PP-OCRv4 text detector.
     */
    CYRILLIC,

    /**
     * Legacy and slower model, supports GPU/CPU.
     */
    LEGACY,

    /**
     * Faster model designed for ARM CPU.
     */
    FAST,

    /**
     * Online Google Lens OCR model.
     */
    GLENS,

    /**
     * Self-hosted OwOCR model.
     */
    OWOCR,

    /**
     * OpenRouter online AI model.
     */
    OPENROUTER,

    /**
     * Google AI / Gemini Vision model.
     */
    GOOGLE,

    /**
     * Бесплатная vision-модель Space Bunny Free через OpenCode Zen.
     */
    ZEN_FREE,

    /**
     * Полностью офлайн Tesseract (модели eng+rus в tar.xz внутри APK,
     * активируются только при включении движка).
     */
    TESSERACT,

    /**
     * Google ML Kit Text Recognition для латинского текста (on-device, модель
     * внутри APK, сеть не нужна). Отдаёт текст построчно с координатами строк.
     */
    MLKIT,
}

3: data class OcrImage(

11:             "OCR image pixels size must match width * height"
12:         }
13:     }
14: }
15: 
16: data class OcrBoundingBox(
17:     val left: Float,
18:     val top: Float,
19:     val right: Float,
20:     val bottom: Float,
21: ) {
22:     val width: Float
23:         get() = right - left
24: 
25:     val height: Float
26:         get() = bottom - top
27: 
28:     fun isValid(): Boolean {
29:         return left < right && top < bottom
30:     }
31: }

34:     Horizontal,
35:     Vertical,
36: }
