142:     /**
143:      * Ленивая инициализация системного движка. Поддерживает ВЫБОР ДВИЖКА
144:      * (по запросу пользователя — как в Zueira's Voice): Google TTS,
145:      * RHVoice, Acapela и любой другой установленный. Пустая настройка =
146:      * движок по умолчанию системы. При смене движка — переинициализация.
147:      */
148:     private fun ensureSystem(context: Context, wantPkg: String? = null, onReady: (TextToSpeech?) -> Unit) {
149:         val wantEngine = wantPkg ?: prefs().systemTtsEngine().get().ifBlank { null }
150:         if (systemTts != null && systemEnginePkg != wantEngine) {
151:             // Пользователь сменил движок — пересоздаём
152:             runCatching { systemTts?.shutdown() }
153:             systemTts = null
154:             systemReady = false
155:             initInProgress = false
156:         }
157:         systemTts?.let {
158:             if (systemReady) { onReady(it); return }
159:         }
160:         if (systemTts == null) {
161:             // Прошлая попытка инициализации провалилась и объект остался
162:             // «вечным null» — все последующие вызовы молча получали onReady(null),
163:             // и офлайн-TTS выглядел мёртвым до перезапуска приложения.
164:             // Теперь упавший движок честно пересоздаётся.
165:             systemEnginePkg = wantEngine
166:             val listener = TextToSpeech.OnInitListener { status ->
167:                 systemReady = status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS
168:                 initInProgress = false
169:                 val ready = if (systemReady) systemTts else null
170:                 onReady(ready)
171:                 // Голоса больше не «исчезают до инициализации»: всё, что было
172:                 // заказано во время старта движка, озвучивается сразу после него.
173:                 val pending = pendingReady.toList()
174:                 pendingReady.clear()
175:                 pending.forEach { it(ready) }
176:             }
177:             initInProgress = true
178:             // Конструктор TextToSpeech может бросить исключение на невалидном/
179:             // удалённом движке (например пакет перестал существовать) —
180:             // глушим и честно пересоздаём; без этого падало всё приложение.
181:             runCatching {
182:                 systemTts = if (wantEngine != null) {
183:                     TextToSpeech(context.applicationContext, listener, wantEngine)
184:                 } else {
185:                     TextToSpeech(context.applicationContext, listener)
186:                 }
187:             }.onFailure {
188:                 systemTts = null
189:                 initInProgress = false
190:                 systemReady = false
191:                 systemEnginePkg = null
192:                 onReady(null)
193:             }
194:         } else if (!initInProgress && !systemReady) {
195:             // Зависший полуинициализированный экземпляр: убираем и пробуем заново.
196:             runCatching { systemTts?.shutdown() }
197:             systemTts = null
198:             onReady(null)
199:         } else {
200:             // Инициализация уже идёт — не дёргаем движок; фразу ставим в
201:             // очередь и озвучиваем из listener'а (раньше она молча терялась).
202:             if (pendingReady.size < 8) {
203:                 pendingReady.addLast(onReady)
204:             } else {
205:                 onReady(null)
206:             }
207:         }
208:     }

210:     /**
211:      * Установленные TTS-движки устройства: (пакет, читаемое имя).
212:      *
213:      * Список берётся ДВУМЯ способами и объединяется:
214:      *
215:      * 1. PackageManager — движки объявляют сервис с интентом
216:      *    `android.intent.action.TTS_SERVICE`. Работает сразу, без ожидания.
217:      * 2. TextToSpeech.engines — но только ПОСЛЕ onInit: раньше здесь стоял
218:      *    мгновенный вызов, и до инициализации сервис не подключён, поэтому
219:      *    сторонние движки (RHVoice, Vocalizer, Acapela) в настройки не
220:      *    попадали вовсе.
221:      *
222:      * Метод блокирующий (до [ENGINE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS]), поэтому вызывать его
223:      * следует вне главного потока.
224:      */
225:     fun installedEngines(context: Context): List<Pair<String, String>> {
226:         val app = context.applicationContext
227:         val found = LinkedHashMap<String, String>()
228: 
229:         // 1) Через PackageManager — не требует инициализации движка.
230:         runCatching {
231:             val pm = app.packageManager
232:             val intent = Intent(TextToSpeech.Engine.INTENT_ACTION_TTS_SERVICE)
233:             val services = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
234:                 pm.queryIntentServices(intent, PackageManager.ResolveInfoFlags.of(0L))
235:             } else {
236:                 @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
237:                 pm.queryIntentServices(intent, 0)
238:             }
239:             services.forEach { info ->
240:                 val pkg = info.serviceInfo?.packageName ?: return@forEach
241:                 val label = runCatching {
242:                     info.serviceInfo.loadLabel(pm).toString()
243:                 }.getOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: pkg
244:                 found.putIfAbsent(pkg, label)
245:             }
246:         }.onFailure { error ->
247:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, error) { "queryIntentServices for TTS failed" }
248:         }
249: 
250:         // 2) Через сам TextToSpeech — дожидаемся onInit.
251:         runCatching {
252:             val ready = CountDownLatch(1)
253:             var probe: TextToSpeech? = null
254:             probe = TextToSpeech(app) { ready.countDown() }
255:             ready.await(ENGINE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
256:             probe?.engines?.forEach { engine ->
257:                 val label = engine.label?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: engine.name
258:                 found[engine.name] = label
259:             }
260:             runCatching { probe?.shutdown() }
261:         }.onFailure { error ->
262:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, error) { "TextToSpeech.engines failed" }
263:         }
264: 
265:         if (found.isEmpty()) {
266:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN) { "No TTS engines found on this device" }
267:         }
268:         return found.map { it.key to it.value }
269:     }

271:     /**
272:      * Голоса СИСТЕМНОГО движка по умолчанию (оффлайн): пары «подпись →
273:      * спецификация пакет::голос». Спецификация передаётся в [speakWithVoice],
274:      * чтобы озвучить текст именно этим голосом (смешивание оффлайн-голосов
275:      * с онлайн-голосами Edge TTS).
276:      */
277:     fun systemVoiceSpecs(context: Context): List<Pair<String, String>> {
278:         val app = context.applicationContext
279:         val specs = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
280:         runCatching {
281:             val ready = CountDownLatch(1)
282:             var tts: TextToSpeech? = null
283:             tts = TextToSpeech(app) {
284:                 ready.countDown()
285:             }
286:             ready.await(ENGINE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
287:             val pkg = runCatching { tts?.defaultEngine }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
288:             tts?.voices
289:                 ?.filter { it.name.isNotBlank() }
290:                 ?.forEach { v ->
291:                     val locale = runCatching { v.locale?.toString().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault("")
292:                     val label = if (locale.isBlank()) v.name else "${v.name} • $locale"
293:                     specs += label to "${pkg}::${v.name}"
294:                 }
295:             runCatching { tts?.shutdown() }
296:         }.onFailure { error ->
297:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, error) { "systemVoiceSpecs failed" }
298:         }
299:         return specs
300:     }

310:     /** v1.9.40: spec голоса роли («пакет::имя») из слотов настроек. */
311:     fun slotVoiceSpec(role: String): String? = runCatching {
312:         // Словарь голосовых ролей имеет приоритет над legacy-слотами:
313:         // роль из {имя:Аки} или кнопки ♀/♂ может быть описана там точнее.
314:         val dictVoice = VoiceRoleDictionary.load(prefs())
315:             .firstOrNull { it.matchesName(role) }
316:             ?.voice
317:             ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
318:         if (dictVoice != null) return@runCatching dictVoice
319:         val arr = org.json.JSONArray(prefs().voiceSlots().get())
320:         (0 until arr.length()).map { i -> arr.getJSONObject(i) }
321:             .firstOrNull { it.optString("role") == role }
322:             ?.optString("voice")
323:             ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
324:     }.getOrNull()
325: 
326:     /**
327:      * v1.9.40: озвучка КОНКРЕТНЫМ голосом («пакет::имя») в обход ролей и ручного
328:      * режима: кнопки «Проба» у слотов и ♀/♂/🎙 на карточке распознанного текста.
329:      * spec пуст = обычный основной голос.
330:      */
331:     fun speakWithVoice(
332:         context: Context,
333:         text: String,
334:         voiceSpec: String?,
335:         onState: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
336:     ) {
337:         if (voiceSpec.isNullOrBlank()) {
338:             speak(context, text, onState)
339:             return
340:         }
341:         stop()
342:         onStateChange = onState
343:         val spoken = SpeechMarkup.forSpeech(SpeechMarkup.strip(text))
344:         if (spoken.isBlank()) {
345:             setSpeaking(false)
346:             return
347:         }
348:         // Голос роли может быть онлайн-голосом Edge TTS (в т.ч. в смешанном
349:         // словаре «онлайн+оффлайн»): маршрутизируем в Edge, а не в системный.
350:         val forcedPkg = voiceSpec.substringBefore("::").trim()
351:         val voiceName = voiceSpec.substringAfterLast("::").trim()
352:         val enginePref = prefs().voiceEngine().get()
353:         val phoneOnly = runCatching { prefs().voicePhoneOnly().get() }.getOrDefault(true)
354:         val edgeName = voiceName.endsWith("Neural", ignoreCase = true) ||
355:             voiceName.startsWith("ru-", ignoreCase = true) ||
356:             voiceName.startsWith("en-", ignoreCase = true)
357:         val wantEdge = when {
358:             // Пакет в спецификации голоса — это осознанный выбор конкретного
359:             // движка («edge::…», «com.github…::…»): телефонный режим его не
360:             // отменяет, иначе проба звучала бы не тем голосом, что и чтение.
361:             forcedPkg.isNotBlank() -> forcedPkg.startsWith("edge", ignoreCase = true)
362:             // Явно выбранный сетевой движок — тоже осознанный выбор.
363:             eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.voice.VoicePlugins.isOnlineEngineId(enginePref) ->
364:                 enginePref == ENGINE_EDGE_TTS || edgeName
365:             // Телефонный режим гасит только автоподстановку сетевого голоса
366:             // по имени: конкретный голос не должен уводить озвучку в сеть.
367:             phoneOnly -> false
368:             else -> edgeName
369:         }
370:         if (wantEdge) {
371:             speakWithEdgeVoice(context, text, voiceName, onState)
372:             return
373:         }
374:         ensureSystem(context, forcedPkg.ifBlank { null }) { engine ->
375:             if (engine == null) {
376:                 setSpeaking(false)
377:                 return@ensureSystem
378:             }
379:             runCatching {
380:                 val p = prefs()
381:                 engine.setSpeechRate(p.speechRate().get().coerceIn(0.5f, 2f))
382:                 engine.setPitch(p.speechPitch().get().coerceIn(0.5f, 2f))
383:                 val name = voiceSpec.substringAfterLast("::")
384:                 engine.voices?.firstOrNull { it.name == name }?.let { engine.setVoice(it) }
385:                 val maxLen = 3500
386:                 val parts = spoken.chunked(maxLen)
387:                 val lastId = "ywv_" + (parts.size - 1)
388:                 engine.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(
389:                     object : UtteranceProgressListener() {
390:                         override fun onStart(utteranceId: String?) {
391:                             if (utteranceId == "ywv_0") setSpeaking(true)
392:                         }
393:                         override fun onDone(utteranceId: String?) {
394:                             if (utteranceId == lastId) setSpeaking(false)
395:                         }
396:                         override fun onError(utteranceId: String?) = setSpeaking(false)
397:                         override fun onError(utteranceId: String?, errorCode: Int) = setSpeaking(false)
398:                     },
399:                 )
400:                 parts.forEachIndexed { i, part ->
401:                     engine.speak(part, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_ADD, null, "ywv_$i")
402:                 }
403:             }.onFailure { setSpeaking(false) }
404:         }
405:     }

407:     /**
408:      * Озвучка текста под роль (кнопки ♀/♂/🎙 на карточке распознанного текста).
409:      * Если для роли настроен голос (словарь ролей / legacy-слоты) — он
410:      * используется напрямую и может быть онлайн (Edge TTS) или оффлайн
411:      * (системный) — «совмещение онлайн и оффлайн голосов». Если голос не
412:      * настроен — обычная озвучка с учётом пола роли (♀/♂ → разные пресеты).

415:         context: Context,
416:         text: String,
417:         role: String,
418:         onState: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
419:     ) {
420:         val spec = slotVoiceSpec(role)
421:         if (spec != null) {
422:             speakWithVoice(context, text, spec, onState)
423:             return
424:         }
425:         val gender = when (role.lowercase()) {
426:             "female" -> "female"
427:             "male" -> "male"
428:             else -> null
429:         }
430:         speakAs(context, text, gender, onState = onState)

457:     /**
458:      * Озвучка с учётом пола говорящего: gender = "female" | "male" | null.
459:      * Для системного движка используется соответствующий голос из пресетов
460:      * (Настройки озвучки → Женский голос / Мужской голос). Для веб-движка
461:      * пол недоступен (у Google Translate один голос на язык).
462:      */
463:     @JvmOverloads
464:     fun speakAs(
465:         context: Context,
466:         text: String,
467:         gender: String?,
468:         speakerSlot: Int = 0,
469:         onState: (Boolean) -> Unit = {},
470:     ) {

331:             engineId == TtsSpeaker.ENGINE_AUTO -> if (online) TtsSpeaker.ENGINE_GOOGLE_WEB else TtsSpeaker.ENGINE_SYSTEM
332:             explicitOnline -> if (online) engineId else TtsSpeaker.ENGINE_SYSTEM

334:         }

364:      * Здесь намеренно НЕ используется `TtsSpeaker.installedEngines()`: вторая
365:      * половина того метода до трёх секунд ждёт `onInit` на `CountDownLatch`, а

375:         val selected = runCatching { prefs.systemTtsEngine().get().trim() }.getOrDefault("")

377:             .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && engines.none { (pkg, _) -> pkg == selected } }
378:             ?.let { pkg -> listOf(pkg to "Выбранный движок ($pkg)") }

384:      * Android TTS-движки, установленные в системе: пакет → человекочитаемое имя.

386:     fun installedSystemEngines(context: Context): List<Pair<String, String>> {
387:         val app = context.applicationContext
388:         return runCatching {
389:             val pm = app.packageManager
390:             val intent = Intent(TextToSpeech.Engine.INTENT_ACTION_TTS_SERVICE)
391:             val services = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
392:                 pm.queryIntentServices(intent, PackageManager.ResolveInfoFlags.of(0L))
393:             } else {
394:                 @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
395:                 pm.queryIntentServices(intent, 0)
396:             }
397:             val found = LinkedHashMap<String, String>()
398:             services.forEach { info ->
399:                 val pkg = info.serviceInfo?.packageName ?: return@forEach
400:                 val label = runCatching { info.serviceInfo.loadLabel(pm).toString() }
401:                     .getOrNull()
402:                     ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
403:                     ?: pkg
404:                 found.putIfAbsent(pkg, label)

243:     private fun trigramSimilarity(a: String, b: String): Float {
244:         if (a.length < 3 || b.length < 3) return if (a == b) 1f else 0f
245:         val ta = HashSet<String>(a.length)
246:         for (i in 0..a.length - 3) ta.add(a.substring(i, i + 3))
247:         var common = 0
248:         var total = 0
249:         for (i in 0..b.length - 3) {
250:             total++
251:             if (b.substring(i, i + 3) in ta) common++
252:         }
253:         return if (total == 0) 0f else common.toFloat() / total
254:     }

1175:         bitmap: Bitmap,
1176:         chapterId: Long,
1177:         pageIndex: Int,
1178:         order: String,

1183:             else -> tachiyomi.core.common.util.system.ReadingDirection.RTL

1186:             cacheKey = "autoread_${chapterId}_$pageIndex",
1187:             image = bitmap,
1188:             originalWidth = bitmap.width,
1189:             originalHeight = bitmap.height,
1190:             direction = direction,
1191:         )

1193:             .map { it.rect }
1194:             .filter { it.width() > 16 && it.height() > 16 }
1195:             .take(MAX_BUBBLES_PER_FRAME)

1197:

1200:             if (job?.isActive != true) break
1201:             // 1) Широкая рамка (ширина > 1.6 высоты) часто обнимает ДВА круглых

1210:                     rect = r,

1212:                     direction = direction,
1213:                 )

1218:             //    чтобы углы квадратного кадрирования не тащили текст соседа.
1219:             val padX = (r.width() * 0.06f).toInt()
1220:             val padY = (r.height() * 0.06f).toInt()
1221:             val left = (r.left - padX).coerceAtLeast(0)
1222:             val top = (r.top - padY).coerceAtLeast(0)
1223:             val right = (r.right + padX).coerceAtMost(bitmap.width)
1224:             val bottom = (r.bottom + padY).coerceAtMost(bitmap.height)

1227:                 bitmap,
1228:                 left,
1229:                 top,
1230:                 right,
1231:                 bottom,

1237:             if (clean.count { it.isLetter() } < 3 && bottom - top > 32) {
1238:                 val dx = ((right - left) * 0.14f).toInt()
1239:                 val dy = ((bottom - top) * 0.14f).toInt()

1241:                     bitmap,
1242:                     left + dx,
1243:                     top + dy,
1244:                     right - dx,
1245:                     bottom - dy,
1246:                     maskRound = false,
1247:                 )
1248:                 clean = normalizeOcrTextForDisplay(text).trim()
1249:             }

1252:                     text = clean,
1253:                     boundingBox = OcrBoundingBox(
1254:                         left = left.toFloat() / bitmap.width,
1255:                         top = top.toFloat() / bitmap.height,
1256:                         right = right.toFloat() / bitmap.width,
1257:                         bottom = bottom.toFloat() / bitmap.height,
1258:                     ),
1259:                 )
1260:             }
1261:         }
1262:         return out
1263:     }

1265:     /**
1266:      * Два круглых облачка вплотную внутри одной широкой рамки: повторный
1267:      * панельный детектор на кадрированном фрагменте находит их по отдельности,
1268:      * каждый распознаётся со своей репликой. Если детектор не нашёл ничего —
1269:      * распознаём всю широкую рамку целиком.
1270:      */
1271:     private suspend fun readBubbleSplits(
1272:         bitmap: Bitmap,
1273:         chapterId: Long,
1274:         pageIndex: Int,
1275:         rect: android.graphics.Rect,
1276:         index: Int,
1277:         direction: tachiyomi.core.common.util.system.ReadingDirection,
1278:     ): List<Line> {
1279:         val out = mutableListOf<Line>()
1280:         val padX = (rect.width() * 0.04f).toInt()
1281:         val padY = (rect.height() * 0.04f).toInt()
1282:         val left = (rect.left - padX).coerceAtLeast(0)
1283:         val top = (rect.top - padY).coerceAtLeast(0)
1284:         val right = (rect.right + padX).coerceAtMost(bitmap.width)
1285:         val bottom = (rect.bottom + padY).coerceAtMost(bitmap.height)
1286:         if (right - left < 16 || bottom - top < 16) return out
1287:         val crop = Bitmap.createBitmap(bitmap, left, top, right - left, bottom - top)
1288:         val kids = try {
1289:             detectPanels.await(
1290:                 cacheKey = "bubble_split_${chapterId}_${pageIndex}_$index",
1291:                 image = crop,
1292:                 originalWidth = crop.width,
1293:                 originalHeight = crop.height,
1294:                 direction = direction,
1295:             ).debugBubbles.map { it.rect }
1296:                 .filter {
1297:                     it.width() > 16 && it.height() > 16 &&
1298:                         (it.width() * it.height()) >= 0.13f * crop.width * crop.height
1299:                 }
1300:         } catch (t: Throwable) {
1301:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, t) { "bubble split detect failed" }
1302:             emptyList()
1303:         } finally {
1304:             if (!crop.isRecycled) crop.recycle()
1305:         }
1306:         if (kids.size < 2) {
1307:             // Детектор не увидел отдельных облачков — читаем всю рамку как есть.
1308:             val text = ocrCroppedRegion(bitmap, left, top, right, bottom, maskRound = false)
1309:             val clean = normalizeOcrTextForDisplay(text).trim()
1310:             if (clean.isNotBlank()) {
1311:                 out += Line(
1312:                     text = clean,
1313:                     boundingBox = normalizeBox(left, top, right, bottom, bitmap),
1314:                 )
1315:             }
1316:             return out
1317:         }
1318:         for (kid in kids.take(MAX_BUBBLES_PER_FRAME)) {
1319:             if (job?.isActive != true) break
1320:             val kPadX = (kid.width() * 0.05f).toInt()
1321:             val kPadY = (kid.height() * 0.05f).toInt()
1322:             val kl = (left + kid.left - kPadX).coerceAtLeast(0)
1323:             val kt = (top + kid.top - kPadY).coerceAtLeast(0)
1324:             val kr = (left + kid.right + kPadX).coerceAtMost(bitmap.width)
1325:             val kb = (top + kid.bottom + kPadY).coerceAtMost(bitmap.height)
1326:             if (kr - kl < 16 || kb - kt < 16) continue
1327:             val text = ocrCroppedRegion(
1328:                 bitmap,
1329:                 kl,
1330:                 kt,
1331:                 kr,
1332:                 kb,
1333:                 maskRound = (kr - kl).toFloat() / (kb - kt) in 0.7f..1.4f,
1334:             )
1335:             val clean = normalizeOcrTextForDisplay(text).trim()
1336:             if (clean.isNotBlank()) {
1337:                 out += Line(clean, normalizeBox(kl, kt, kr, kb, bitmap))
1338:             }
1339:         }
1340:         return out
1341:     }

1360:             bubbleOcr.getText(OcrImage(ocrBitmap.width, ocrBitmap.height, pixels))

1380:     /** Круглая маска: углы квадратного облачка убираются (пустые), текст

1382:     private fun maskCircle(src: Bitmap): Bitmap {
1383:         val masked = Bitmap.createBitmap(src.width, src.height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
1384:         val canvas = android.graphics.Canvas(masked)
1385:         canvas.drawBitmap(src, 0f, 0f, null)

1387:             isAntiAlias = true
1388:             xfermode = android.graphics.PorterDuffXfermode(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR)
1389:         }
1390:         canvas.drawOval(
1391:             android.graphics.RectF(0f, 0f, src.width.toFloat(), src.height.toFloat()),
1392:             erase,

1394:         // Полностью прозрачные углы заливаем белым: для OCR чёрный/прозрачный
1395:         // фон в углах вреднее белого.
1396:         val px = IntArray(masked.width * masked.height)

1436:         if (lines.size <= 1) return lines

1439:         var current: Line? = null

1445:                     boundingBox = union(cur.boundingBox, line.boundingBox),
1446:                 )
1447:             } else {
1448:                 current?.let { merged += it }
1449:                 current = line
1450:             }
1451:         }
1452:         current?.let { merged += it }

1454:     }

1456:     /** Обе строки выровнены (одна колонка/облачко) и стоят вплотную. */
1457:     private fun sameBubble(a: Line, b: Line): Boolean {
1458:         val ab = a.boundingBox
1459:         val bb = b.boundingBox

1461:         val bW = bb.right - bb.left

1463:         // Перекрытие по горизонтали ≥ 50% ширины меньшей строки — один «столбец».
1464:         val overlap = kotlin.math.min(ab.right, bb.right) - kotlin.math.max(ab.left, bb.left)
1465:         if (overlap <= 0f) return false
1466:         if (overlap / kotlin.math.min(aW, bW) < 0.5f) return false
1467:         // Зазор между строками одного облачка много меньше зазора между
1468:         // облачками (у диалогов и рамок есть пустое поле между ними).
1469:         val aH = ab.bottom - ab.top
1470:         val bH = bb.bottom - bb.top
1471:         if (aH <= 0f || bH <= 0f) return false
1472:         val gap = bb.top - ab.bottom
1473:         if (gap < 0f || gap > kotlin.math.max(aH, bH) * 0.55f) return false
1474:         // Вертикальные японские колонки (узкие и очень высокие) не склеиваем.
1475:         // Порог 4x вместо 2x: у manga-диалогов облачка бывают вытянутыми по высоте.
1476:         if (aH > aW * 4f || bH > bW * 4f) return false

1478:     }

1709:          * [BAND_TOLERANCE] на неточность координат OCR).
1710:          */
1711:         private fun groupIntoBands(lines: List<Line>): List<List<Line>> {
1712:             val bands = mutableListOf<MutableList<Line>>()
1713:             var bandBottom = 0f
1714:             for (line in lines.sortedBy { it.boundingBox.top }) {
1715:                 val box = line.boundingBox
1716:                 val current = bands.lastOrNull()
1717:                 if (current == null || box.top >= bandBottom - BAND_TOLERANCE) {
1718:                     bands += mutableListOf(line)
1719:                     bandBottom = box.bottom
1720:                 } else {
1721:                     current += line
1722:                     bandBottom = maxOf(bandBottom, box.bottom)

1730:         /**
1731:          * Чистка OCR-мусора ВНУТРИ реплики (по скриншотам пользователя:
1732:          * «АХЕ возьмешь — МЕНЯ НА РУЧКИ? eS la 4…», «Я | | > | КАК ПРИНЦЕСС…»,
1733:          * «РУ у 4а (WX i ДЖЕЙН…»). Правила:
1734:          *  • строки из символов-палок/скобок/стрелок выбрасываются целиком;
1735:          *  • строки, где смесь латиницы+цифр не похожа на слова (eS la 4,
1736:          *    WX i, 4a) — выбрасываются при целевом языке ru;
1737:          *  • одиночные буквы-обрывки («о», «Я» без продолжения в 1 строку из
1738:          *    многих) — выбрасываются;
1739:          *  • остальные строки склеиваются пробелом.
1740:          */
1741:         fun cleanOcrGarbage(text: String, language: String): String {
1742:             val rawRows = text.lines()
1743:                 .map { OcrTextCleaner.stripPromotionalText(it).trim() }
1744:                 .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
1745:             // Короткие целые слова («шум», «гам») OCR-чистка больше не кромсает:
1746:             // одиночное слово из букв проходит без правок и фильтров.
1747:             val singleWord = rawRows.singleOrNull()
1748:             if (singleWord != null && singleWord.length in 3..14 && singleWord.all { it.isLetter() }) {
1749:                 return singleWord
1750:             }
1751:             // OCR часто путает буквы с цифрами («4» вместо «а», «1» вместо «л»).
1752:             // Убираем только ЦИФРЫ, слипшиеся с буквой (4а, а4, eS la 4) — это
1753:             // типичная ошибка OCR. Самостоятельные числа («1», «глава 1», «5»)
1754:             // НЕ трогаем: пользователь просил, чтобы цифры озвучивались
1755:             // («он цифры не говорит почему-то»). Чисто числовые строки-мусор
1756:             // («2/89», «7») отсекаются ниже по isMeaningfulRow (нет букв).
1757:             val rows = rawRows.map { row ->
1758:                 row.replace(Regex("(?<=[\\p{L}])[0-9]+|[0-9]+(?=[\\p{L}])"), " ")
1759:                     .replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim()
1760:             }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
1761:             if (rows.isEmpty()) return ""
1762:             val kept = rows.filter { row -> isMeaningfulRow(row, language) }
1763:             // Если ВСЁ забраковано, но исходник был длинный — вернём самую
1764:             // «словесную» строку, чтобы не терять настоящие реплики.
1765:             if (kept.isEmpty()) {
1766:                 val best = rows.maxByOrNull { r -> r.count { it.isLetter() } }
1767:                 return if (best != null && best.count { it.isLetter() } >= 4) best else ""
1768:             }
1769:             // Склейка строк с учётом переноса слова в конце строки:
1770:             // «понеде-» + «льник» → «понедельник», иначе обычный пробел.
1771:             val joined = StringBuilder()
1772:             for (row in kept) {
1773:                 if (joined.isNotEmpty()) {
1774:                     if (joined.lastOrNull() == '-') {
1775:                         joined.deleteCharAt(joined.length - 1)
1776:                     } else {
1777:                         joined.append(' ')
1778:                     }
1779:                 }
1780:                 joined.append(row)
1781:             }

1784:             // генерирует на шумных кадрах: "!!!!" → "!", "????" → "?", "......" → "…"

1786:                 val ch = m.groupValues[1]
1787:                 when (ch) {
1788:                     "!", "?", ".", "…", "~" -> ch
1789:                     else -> m.value
1790:                 }
1791:             }
1792:             return result
1793:         }

1795:         /** Похожа ли строка на осмысленный текст (не обрывок/не мусор). */
1796:         private fun isMeaningfulRow(row: String, language: String): Boolean {
1797:             val letters = row.count { it.isLetter() }
1798:             val total = row.length
1799:             // Палки, скобки, стрелки, точки: буквы < 40% строки — мусор
1800:             if (letters == 0) return false
1801:             if (letters.toFloat() / total < 0.4f && total >= 3) return false
1802:             // Одна-две буквы — настоящие русские слова (я, и, в, с, но, не…)
1803:             if (letters <= 2) {
1804:                 if (language != "ru") return false
1805:                 val compact = row.filter(Char::isLetter).lowercase()
1806:                 if (isShortRussianWord(compact)) return true
1807:                 return compact.length == 2 &&
1808:                     compact.all { it in '\u0400'..'\u04FF' } &&
1809:                     Regex("^[\\p{L}][\\s—–-]+[\\p{L}][.!?…]*$").matches(row)
1810:             }
1811:             when (language) {
1812:                 "ru" -> {
1813:                     val cyr = row.count { it in '\u0400'..'\u04FF' }
1814:                     // Латиница с цифрами (eS la 4, WX i) при русском языке — мусор
1815:                     if (cyr == 0) return false
1816:                     if (cyr.toFloat() / letters < 0.6f) return false
1817:                     // Должно быть хотя бы одно «слово» из 3+ кириллических букв
1818:                     return Regex("[\\u0400-\\u04FF]{3,}").containsMatchIn(row)
1819:                 }
1820:                 "en" -> {
1821:                     val lat = row.count { it in 'a'..'z' || it in 'A'..'Z' }
1822:                     if (lat.toFloat() / letters < 0.6f) return false
1823:                     return Regex("[A-Za-z]{3,}").containsMatchIn(row)
1824:                 }
1825:                 else -> return true
1826:             }
1827:         }

1829:         /** Финальная проверка собранной реплики перед чтением. */
1830:         fun isMeaningful(text: String, language: String): Boolean {
1831:             if (text.isBlank()) return false
1832:             if (OcrTextCleaner.isPromotionalText(text)) return false
1833:             if (!matchesLanguage(text, language)) return false
1834:             // Служебная навигация сайта: «— том 1 глава 1 →», «том 1 глава 1»,
1835:             // «← том 3 глава 5 →». Это шапка/футер манга-ридера, а не реплика;
1836:             // раньше авточтение постоянно зачитывало эти подписи и стрелки.
1837:             if (isSiteChromeNoise(text)) return false
1838:             val words = text.split(Regex("\\s+"))
1839:             return words.any { w -> w.count { it.isLetter() } >= 3 } ||
1840:                 // Короткие настоящие русские слова (я, и, но, не…) — читаем.
1841:                 (language == "ru" && words.any { isShortRussianWord(it.filter(Char::isLetter)) }) ||
1842:                 // …или короткая осмысленная («Да!», «Ах!», «Нет?»)
1843:                 (text.length in 2..6 && text.count { it.isLetter() } >= 2)
1844:         }

1846:         /**

1848:          * зачитывать: подписи «том N глава N», счётчик страниц «N/M» и

1851:          */

1853:             val t = text.trim()
1854:             if (t.isBlank()) return false
1855:             val letters = t.count { it.isLetter() }
1856:             if (letters > 0) {
1857:                 // «— том 1 глава 1 →», «том 1, глава 2», «← том 3 глава 5 →».

parts.text:
Very important! Look at lines 225-377: the LaunchedEffect that builds `allVoiceChoices`.

Key finding #1 (line 252-280): for the default/currently selected engine (`readyProbe`), the choices are created with `key = voice.name` — NO package prefix! So for the currently selected engine, the key is just the bare voice name, e.g. `ru-ru-x-dfc-local`.

But for other installed engines (lines 290-328), the key is `"$pkg::${v.name}"` — WITH the package prefix.

So the id format is inconsistent: the current engine's voices get a bare name key, other engines get `pkg::name`.

Now, when playing:
- `speakWithVoice(context, text, voiceSpec)`: `forcedPkg = voiceSpec.substringBefore("::").trim()`. For a bare name (no "::"), `substringBefore("::")` returns the **whole string** (the voice name!) when the delimiter is absent. E.g. `"ru-ru-x-dfc-local".substringBefore("::")` = `"ru-ru-x-dfc-local"`. Then `.trim()` → non-blank. So `forcedPkg` = the voice name, and `wantEdge` = `forcedPkg.startsWith("edge", ignoreCase=true)` → false typically. Then `ensureSystem(context, forcedPkg.ifBlank { null })` → `wantEngine = "ru-ru-x-dfc-local"` → `TextToSpeech(context, listener, "ru-ru-x-dfc-local")` — that's an invalid package name! The constructor will throw or return an engine that fails init. This is a critical bug: the engine package is set to the voice name.

Actually wait. Let's double check: in `speakWithVoice`, `forcedPkg = voiceSpec.substringBefore("::").trim()`. Kotlin's `String.substringBefore(delimiter, missingDelimiterValue = this)`. Yes, if the delimiter is not found, it returns the original string. So for a bare voice name, `forcedPkg == voiceSpec` (the voice name).

Then `edgeName` = voiceName.endsWith("Neural") || startsWith("ru-") || startsWith("en-"). For Google Speech Services voice names like `ru-ru-x-dfc-local`, voiceName starts with "ru-" → `edgeName = true`!! So `wantEdge`:
- `forcedPkg.isNotBlank()` → true (it's the voice name!) → `forcedPkg.startsWith("edge")` → false. So wantEdge = false. Good, it stays system.
- Then `ensureSystem(context, forcedPkg.ifBlank { null })` → wantEngine = "ru-ru-x-dfc-local" → `TextToSpeech(app, listener, "ru-ru-x-dfc-local")`.

Android's TextToSpeech constructor with an invalid engine package: it queries the service; if not found, onInit is called with ERROR. So systemReady = false, onReady(null) → `setSpeaking(false)`, no speech. That's exactly "list shows local voices, selecting them produces no speech".

Hold on — but is `TtsSettingsDialog` the place where local voices are chosen? The choices built there are used for:
1. `selectedVoice` (prefs.voiceName()) — set later? Let me check where selectedVoice is saved.
2. `voiceFemale` / `voiceMale` prefs.
3. `onSelect = { name -> ... put("voice", name) }` in the "add slot" dialog.

And `VoiceChoice.key` = `voice.name` for the active engine. So `pref_voice_name` = bare voice name (e.g. "ru-ru-x-dfc-local"), and voiceSlots voice = bare name or "pkg::name".

Now in `speakSystem()` (TtsSpeaker line 589-594):
```kotlin
val forcedPkg = (
    roleVoice?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it.contains("::") }?.substringBefore("::")
        ?: primaryRaw.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it.contains("::") }?.substringBefore("::")
        ?: slotVoiceRaw.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it.contains("::") }?.substringBefore("::")
        ?: savedRawVoice.takeIf { it.contains("::") }?.substringBefore("::")
    )?.ifBlank { null }
```
Here it correctly checks `contains("::")` before splitting. So in speakSystem, a bare voice name doesn't set a bogus package. Good — speakSystem is safe.

But `speakWithVoice` is NOT safe: it uses `substringBefore("::")` without checking presence. That's the "local voice" path: TtsVoicePickerDialog's system rows → `onPickSystem(spec)` → ReaderActivity: `speakWithVoice(context, queryText, spec)`.

Now for TtsVoicePickerDialog, the specs come from `TtsSpeaker.systemVoiceSpecs(context)` which builds `"${pkg}::${v.name}"` — that always includes "::" IF `pkg` is non-blank. `pkg = runCatching { tts?.defaultEngine }.getOrNull().orEmpty()`. If defaultEngine works, pkg is non-blank. So for the picker dialog the spec always has "::" → forcedPkg is the real package → correct.

Hmm, so where's the actual "local voice" list that gets selected? The TtsSettingsDialog VoiceGrid (keys = bare voice names for the active engine) and the "Проба" buttons. And BooksReaderScreen's picker (which uses systemVoiceSpecs, fine).

Let me now read the rest of TtsSettingsDialog to see the main voice selection (VoiceGrid for main voice) and how selectedVoice is saved.

225:         pitchHz: Int = 0,
226:         useCache: Boolean = false,
227:     ): File? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
228:         val cleanText = sanitizeForSsml(text)
229:         if (cleanText.isBlank()) return@withContext null
230:         val cacheDir = File(context.cacheDir, "edge_tts").apply { mkdirs() }
231:         val cached = audioCacheFile(cacheDir, cleanText, voice, ratePercent, pitchHz)
232:         if (useCache && cached.isFile && cached.length() >= 1024) return@withContext cached
233:         val target = if (useCache) {
234:             File.createTempFile("edge_", ".mp3", cacheDir)
235:         } else {
236:             File(context.cacheDir, "tts_edge_${System.nanoTime()}.mp3")
237:         }
238:         var completed = false
239:         try {
240:             target.outputStream().buffered().use { output ->
241:                 for (chunk in chunkForSsml(cleanText)) {
242:                     val data = speakChunk(chunk, voice, ratePercent, pitchHz, 0)
243:                     if (data.isEmpty()) {
244:                         throw IllegalStateException("EdgeTTS returned an empty chunk for $voice")
245:                     }
246:                     output.write(data)
247:                 }
248:             }
249:             if (!useCache) {
250:                 completed = true
251:                 target
252:             } else {
253:                 if (!target.renameTo(cached)) {
254:                     target.copyTo(cached, overwrite = true)
255:                     target.delete()
256:                 }
257:                 pruneAudioCache(cacheDir)
258:                 if (cached.length() < 1024) {
259:                     cached.delete()
260:                     null
261:                 } else {
262:                     completed = true
263:                     cached
264:                 }
265:             }
266:         } catch (e: CancellationException) {
267:             throw e
268:         } catch (e: Exception) {
269:             logcat(LogPriority.WARN, e) { "EdgeTTS synthesis failed" }
270:             null
271:         } finally {
272:             if (!completed && target.exists()) target.delete()
273:         }
274:     }
275: 
276:     internal fun chunkForSsml(text: String, limit: Int = SSML_BYTE_LIMIT): List<String> {
277:         if (text.isBlank() || limit <= 0) return emptyList()
278:         val chunks = mutableListOf<String>()
279:         var start = 0
280:         while (start < text.length) {
281:             while (start < text.length && text[start].isWhitespace()) start++
282:             if (start >= text.length) break
283:             if (escapeXml(text.substring(start)).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= limit) {
284:                 chunks += text.substring(start).trim()
285:                 break
286:             }
287:             var low = start + 1
288:             var high = text.length
289:             var end = start
290:             while (low <= high) {
291:                 val middle = (low + high) ushr 1
292:                 val size = escapeXml(text.substring(start, middle)).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size
293:                 if (size <= limit) {
294:                     end = middle
295:                     low = middle + 1
296:                 } else {
297:                     high = middle - 1
298:                 }
299:             }
300:             if (end <= start) end = (start + 1).coerceAtMost(text.length)
301:             val usefulStart = start + (end - start) * 3 / 4
302:             val whitespace = text.substring(usefulStart, end).lastIndexOfAny(charArrayOf(' ', '\n', '\r', '\t'))
303:             val cut = if (whitespace >= 0) usefulStart + whitespace + 1 else end
304:             chunks += text.substring(start, cut).trim()
305:             start = cut
306:         }
307:         return chunks.filter(String::isNotBlank)
308:     }
309: 
310:     private fun sanitizeForSsml(text: String): String = buildString(text.length) {
311:         for (char in text) {
312:             when {
313:                 char == '\n' || char == '\r' || char == '\t' -> append(char)
314:                 char.code in 0..31 || char.code in 127..159 -> Unit
315:                 else -> append(char)
316:             }
317:         }
318:     }.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', '\n').trim()
319: 
320:     private fun audioCacheFile(
321:         directory: File,
322:         text: String,
323:         voice: String,
324:         ratePercent: Int,
325:         pitchHz: Int,
326:     ): File {
327:         val source = "$voice|$ratePercent|$pitchHz|$text"
328:         val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
329:             .digest(source.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
330:             .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 0xFF) }
331:         return File(directory, "$digest.mp3")
332:     }
333: 
334:     private fun pruneAudioCache(directory: File) {
335:         val files = directory.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.extension.equals("mp3", true) }
336:             ?.sortedBy { it.lastModified() }
337:             .orEmpty()
338:         var totalBytes = files.sumOf(File::length)
339:         var remaining = files.size
340:         for (file in files) {
341:             if (remaining <= AUDIO_CACHE_FILES && totalBytes <= AUDIO_CACHE_BYTES) break
342:             val size = file.length()
343:             if (file.delete()) {
344:                 totalBytes -= size
345:                 remaining--
346:             }
347:         }
348:     }
349: 
350:     /** Один SSML-запрос на WebSocket, возвращает конкатенированный MP3. */
351:     private suspend fun speakChunk(
352:         text: String,
353:         voice: String,
354:         ratePercent: Int,
355:         pitchHz: Int,
356:         volumePercent: Int,
357:     ): ByteArray = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
358:             val requestId = uuidHex()
359:             val url = WSS_URL +
360:                 "&Sec-MS-GEC=${secMsGec()}" +
361:                 "&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=$SEC_MS_GEC_VERSION" +
362:                 "&ConnectionId=$requestId"
363:             val request = Request.Builder()
364:                 .url(url)
365:                 .header("User-Agent", userAgent)
366:                 .header("Pragma", "no-cache")
367:                 .header("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
368:                 .header("Origin", "chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold")
369:                 .header("Sec-WebSocket-Version", "13")
370:                 .header("Cookie", "muid=${uuidHex().uppercase()};")
371:                 .build()
372:             val ws = client.newWebSocket(request, EdgeSocketListener(
373:                 requestId = requestId,
374:                 voice = voice,
375:                 text = text,
376:                 ratePercent = ratePercent,
377:                 pitchHz = pitchHz,
378:                 volumePercent = volumePercent,
379:                 onResult = { bytes -> if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(bytes) },
380:                 onError = { error ->
381:                     if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(ByteArray(0))
382:                     if (error != null) logcat(LogPriority.WARN, error) { "EdgeTTS websocket error" }
383:                 },
384:             ))
385:             cont.invokeOnCancellation { ws.cancel() }
386:         }
387: 
388:     /** Собирает MP3 из бинарных аудио-сообщений WebSocket-соединения. */
389:     private class EdgeSocketListener(
390:         private val requestId: String,
391:         private val voice: String,
392:         private val text: String,
393:         private val ratePercent: Int,
394:         private val pitchHz: Int,
395:         private val volumePercent: Int,
396:         private val onResult: (ByteArray) -> Unit,
397:         private val onError: (Throwable?) -> Unit,
398:     ) : WebSocketListener() {
399: 
400:         private val audio = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
401:         private var finished = false
402: 
403:         override fun onOpen(webSocket: WebSocket, response: Response) {
404:             val ts = jsTimestamp()
405:             webSocket.send(
406:                 "X-Timestamp:$ts\r\n" +
407:                     "Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\n" +
408:                     "Path:speech.config\r\n\r\n" +
409:                     "{\"context\":{\"synthesis\":{\"audio\":{\"metadataoptions\":" +
410:                     "{\"sentenceBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\",\"wordBoundaryEnabled\":\"true\"}," +
411:                     "\"outputFormat\":\"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3\"}}}}\r\n",
412:             )
413:             val s = escapeXml(text)
414:             val rate = if (ratePercent >= 0) "+$ratePercent%" else "$ratePercent%"
415:             val pitch = if (pitchHz >= 0) "+${pitchHz}Hz" else "${pitchHz}Hz"
416:             val vol = if (volumePercent >= 0) "+$volumePercent%" else "$volumePercent%"
417:             val language = voice.substringBefore('-', "en").lowercase(Locale.US)
418:             val ssml =
419:                 "<speak version='1.0' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis' " +
420:                     "xml:lang='$language'><voice name='${escapeXml(voice)}'>" +
421:                     "<prosody pitch='$pitch' rate='$rate' volume='$vol'>$s</prosody>" +
422:                     "</voice></speak>"
423:             webSocket.send(
424:                 "X-RequestId:$requestId\r\n" +
425:                     "Content-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\n" +
426:                     "X-Timestamp:${ts}Z\r\n" +
427:                     "Path:ssml\r\n\r\n$ssml",
428:             )
429:         }
430: 
431:         override fun onMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, text: String) {
432:             // Path:turn.end — конец аудио для этого запроса.
433:             if (text.contains("turn.end")) finish(webSocket)
434:         }
435: 
436:         override fun onMessage(webSocket: WebSocket, bytes: ByteString) {
437:             val n = bytes.size
438:             if (n < 2) return
439:             val headerLength = ((bytes[0].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or (bytes[1].toInt() and 0xFF)
440:             if (2 + headerLength > n) return
441:             val header = bytes.substring(2, 2 + headerLength).utf8()
442:             if (header.contains("Path:audio", ignoreCase = true) &&
443:                 header.contains("Content-Type:audio/mpeg", ignoreCase = true)
444:             ) {
445:                 // Аудио идёт сразу после заголовка + \r\n\r\n (2 байта).
446:                 val data = bytes.substring(2 + headerLength)
447:                 if (data.size > 0) audio.write(data.toByteArray())
448:             }
449:         }
450: 
451:         override fun onClosed(webSocket: WebSocket, code: Int, reason: String) {
452:             if (!finished) {
453:                 finished = true
454:                 onError(null)
455:             }
456:         }
457: 
458:         override fun onFailure(webSocket: WebSocket, t: Throwable, response: Response?) {
459:             if (!finished) {
460:                 finished = true
461:                 onError(t)
462:             }
463:         }
464: 
465:         private fun finish(webSocket: WebSocket) {
466:             if (finished) return
467:             finished = true
468:             runCatching { webSocket.close(1000, "ok") }
469:             onResult(audio.toByteArray())
470:         }
471:     }
472: }

package eu.kanade.tachiyomi.data.tts

/**
 * Театральные ремарки и междометия: что произнести и как.
 *
 * Проблема была в трёх местах. Первое: ремарка в скобках попадала в синтез
 * либо выбрасывалась совсем, либо читалась словом — «(вздох)» звучало как
 * «вздох». Второе: `а`, `аа`, `ааа` не различались, хотя означают разное —
 * удивление, попытку закричать, крик. Третье: состояние персонажа (бежит,
 * устал, обессилел, зовёт помощь) вообще не влияло на голос.
 *
 * Ремарки делятся на два вида, и это не украшение, а смысл:
 *
 *  * **звук** (вздох, вдох, стон, крик, смех, кашель) — ПРОИЗНОСИТСЯ.
 *    Синтезатор не умеет вздыхать, поэтому звук передаётся вытянутым
 *    «А-а-а», а характер звука берёт на себя питч и темп;
 *  * **состояние** (шёпот, бег, усталость, слабость, боль, испуг, злость) —
 *    НЕ произносится, а меняет подачу всей реплики. Произносить слово
 *    «шёпот» вслух нельзя, это сломало бы чтение.
 *
 * Ничего не теряется: неизвестная ремарка просто снимается, но любой звук из
 * таблицы произносится, а любое состояние доходит до голоса модификатором.
 *
 * Модуль чистый — без Android и без движка, поэтому проверяется на JVM.
 */
object SpeechCue {

    /** Как произнести один кусок реплики. */
    data class Delivery(
        val text: String,
        val pitch: Float = 1.0f,
        val rate: Float = 1.0f,
        val pauseAfterMs: Int = 0,
        /**
         * Кусок пришёл из звука или междометия, то есть его подача уже
         * задана здесь. Движок в этом случае не добавляет поверх знаковую
         * пунктуацию, иначе «Ааа!» получил бы крик дважды.
         */
        val fromCue: Boolean = false,
        /**
         * Кусок — настоящий звук (вздох, стон, крик), который обычный голос
         * не умеет произносить, а лишь читает буквами. Такие куски — ровно те,
         * что мост отправляет в плагин озвучки; междометия и обычный текст
         * остаются на голосе.
         */
        val isSound: Boolean = false,
        /**
         * Тип звука («sigh», «moan», «cry», …). Плагину нужен именно тип: он
         * подбирает нужный образец, а не читает подставленный текст.
         */
        val soundId: String? = null,
    )

    /** Типы звуков: стабильные ключи для плагина, порядок как в [SOUNDS]. */
    object SoundId {
        const val CRY_FOR_HELP = "cry_for_help"
        const val CRY = "cry"
        const val MOAN = "moan"
        const val GASP = "gasp"
        const val SIGH = "sigh"
        const val LAUGH = "laugh"
        const val COUGH = "cough"
    }

    /** Звук: что говорить и каким голосом. */
    class Sound(
        val spoken: String,
        val pitch: Float,
        val rate: Float,
        val pauseMs: Int,
        val words: List<String>,
        /** Тип звука для плагина озвучки, см. [SoundId]. */

All confirmed. I now have a complete and line-accurate picture. Time to write the final report.

Structure per the user's six questions:
1. How the list of local/system voices is built and what ID each entry has.
2. Which engine handles local/system voice playback.
3. Where engine id / ttsService / URI is lost or mismatched.
4. Every catch/stub that can produce silence.
5. Every case where text is empty.
6. Whether a probe/warm-up exists and whether it happens.
Then: the single most likely root cause + minimal change.

Let me write it clearly with file:line references and short quoted snippets. No modifications made.

Let me be careful and concise but complete. I'll use a summary table for the ID inconsistency.

Key findings to report:

**Producer A — TtsVoicePickerDialog (quick picker on recognized text)** → `TtsSpeaker.systemVoiceSpecs` (TtsSpeaker.kt:277-300) → spec = `"$pkg::$name"` where pkg = `tts.defaultEngine` of a throwaway probe TTS. Consumer: ReaderActivity.kt:1295-1300 `speakWithVoice`. ✅ correct format (unless pkg is empty → "::name").

**Producer B — TtsSettingsDialog main grid** (TtsSettingsDialog.kt:274-279) → key = bare `voice.name` for the ACTIVE engine (`pref_system_tts_engine` or default). Consumers:
- saved to `voiceName`/`voiceFemale`/`voiceMale` (1148-1150, 1176-1178) → read by `speakSystem` (safe).
- chosen for a role slot → saved to `voiceSlots` (541-543) → `speakWithVoice` via slot "Проба" (481) and via `speakRole` (414-418 ← `slotVoiceSpec` 311-324) → **BROKEN**.
- chosen for a role in the dictionary (1295-1300) → role "Проба" (593) → `speakWithVoice` → **BROKEN**.
- also `speakSystem` uses it via `primaryRaw` with `contains("::")` guard → safe.

**Producer C — TtsSettingsDialog other engines** (306-313) → `"$pkg::$name"`; and the "default voice" placeholder (320-327) → `"$pkg::"`. These are correct.

**Producer D — OcrQueueScreen** (687-691 VoiceRow.name = v.name; stored 703-705, 895-897, 915-917) → bare, same as B. Its "▶ Прослушать" (1005-1010) uses `TtsSpeaker.speak` (safe).

**Consumer — BooksReaderScreen** (252-279 stores `bookVoiceSpec` bare or pkg::; 270-272 always `TextToSpeech(context)` = default engine, ignores the package; 340-364+409-428 setVoice by name with the default engine and swallow failure).

**Engine handling**:
- `TtsSpeaker.speakAs` (464-515) → `VoicePlugins.resolveSpeakEngine` (VoicePlugins.kt:324-336) → `speakSystem` (558) for `system_tts`/auto-offline/phoneOnly.
- `ensureSystem` (148-208) binds `TextToSpeech(app, listener, wantEngine)` where wantEngine = the spec's package, else `pref_system_tts_engine` (149).
- `speakSystem` (589-594) extracts the package ONLY when `contains("::")` → correct guard.

**Root cause (highest confidence)**: `speakWithVoice` (350) has no `contains("::")` guard, unlike `speakSystem` (590-593). For a bare name → `forcedPkg = "ru-ru-x-dfc-local"` → line 361 `wantEdge = forcedPkg.startsWith("edge")` = false → line 374 `ensureSystem(context, "ru-ru-x-dfc-local")` → line 183 `TextToSpeech(app, listener, "ru-ru-x-dfc-local")` → the framework finds no TTS service with that package → `onInit(ERROR)` → `onReady(null)` → lines 375-378 `setSpeaking(false)`. Also line 150: if a working engine exists, it is **shut down** (152) because `systemEnginePkg != wantEngine`. No toast, no `markFailure`, no log → complete silence.
Reachable from: slot "Проба" (TtsSettingsDialog:481), role "Проба" (593), ♀/♂/🎙 buttons on the recognized-text card (ReaderActivity:1264 → `speakRole` → `slotVoiceSpec` → `speakWithVoice`).

**Second problem (independent)**: `speakWithVoice` discards `engine.speak()`'s return code (400-402) and never calls `markFailure` (contrast 475 in `speakAs`, 825-828 and 539-543 in `speakSystem`). So a voice rejected with `ERROR` produces no `onStart` and no failure state → `AutoReadEngine.speakAndAwait` (1062-1108) reports `SpeakOutcome.SILENT`/`REJECTED` from a **stale** `lastFailure` (it was never reset by `speakWithVoice`). Note that `speakAndAwait` itself calls `speakAs`, so this only matters for the manual path + the stale-state hazard.

**Third problem**: `speakSystem` line 700/697 hardcodes `Locale("ru","RU")`; `VoiceHelper.pick` → `pickFor(..., "ru", ...)` (VoiceHelper.kt:292) hardcodes "ru" and does exact-name matching (301) within ru-filtered voices only. If the user picks a non-ru local voice from the "Все" list (TtsSettingsDialog:938 shows non-ru languages; OcrQueueScreen has a lang filter defaulting to "ru" at 608), the exact match fails → a different ru voice is chosen, or `chosen == null` → `engine.language = ru-RU` → speak returns ERROR → REJECTED (825-828). So a non-ru local voice never speaks.

**Fourth**: `systemVoiceSpecs` (277-300) always probes the **Android default** engine, ignoring `pref_system_tts_engine`; if the user's chosen engine is not the default, the "📱 Системные голоса (оффлайн)" list shows the default engine's voices and the spec forces the default engine package, i.e. `ensureSystem` re-binds away from the chosen engine. Also `pkg` can be `""` (line 287, timeout at 286) → spec `"::ru-…"` → `forcedPkg` = "" → `wantEdge` falls to the `phoneOnly`/enginePref branch; with `phoneOnly=false` and an online engine pref, `edgeName` (354-356, `startsWith("ru-")`) routes a **local** voice into Edge TTS.

**Fifth**: `VoiceModeResolver.applyToTts` (156-170) hardcodes `"ru"` and passes `null` as the engine package, and it is **dead code** — `resolve()`/`applyToTts()` have no callers (only `currentMode()`/`narratorGender()` are used, AutoReadEngine.kt:706-710). So the per-role engines `pref_voice_male_engine`/`pref_voice_female_engine` are never honored: `speakAs` uses only the global `voiceEngine` (502). Also `resolve()` classifies `ENGINE_REMOTE` as "local" (VoiceModeResolver.kt:~75).

**Sixth**: `BooksReaderScreen` (252-279, 340-364, 409-428) — separate implementation: bare name kept, but `TextToSpeech(context)` is always the default engine, and `setVoice` is inside a `runCatching` whose result is ignored → wrong engine/voice or default voice, silently.

**Silent catches/stubs inventory**:
- TtsSpeaker:280-298 `runCatching` around `systemVoiceSpecs` → empty list, only a WARN log.
- TtsSpeaker:181-193 `runCatching` around the `TextToSpeech` ctor → `onReady(null)`, no user-visible signal; `speakWithVoice` (375-378) and `speakSystemVoiceTest` (847-850) just clear the flag.
- TtsSpeaker:194-198 hung half-init → `onReady(null)`.
- TtsSpeaker:194-206 `pendingReady` overflow (>8) → `onReady(null)`.
- TtsSpeaker:379-403 `runCatching` inside `speakWithVoice` → `.onFailure { setSpeaking(false) }` — no log, no markFailure.
- TtsSpeaker:400-402 `speak()` return ignored.
- TtsSpeaker:388-399 `onError` overrides → only `setSpeaking(false)`, no markFailure (contrast `utteranceFailed` at 539-543 used by `speakSystem` at 753-755).
- TtsSpeaker:619 `advisorVoice` / `primaryRaw.substringAfterLast("::").ifBlank { LocalVoiceAdvisor.recommend(...) }` — note: `advisorVoice` is a non-null String, so `presetVoice = advisorVoice ?: ...` at 620 always takes the left branch; the `?: when (gender)` fallback at 620-624 is **dead code**. Consequence: the per-gender presets `voiceFemale()`/`voiceMale()` are consulted by the `else ->` branch at 656-662 (`p.voiceName()`) — no wait, the `else` branch uses `p.voiceName()`, NOT the gender presets. So **for a line with gender == null (the common case), the ♀/♂ gender presets are never used**; and for gender != null, `presetVoice` is `advisorVoice` which is `primaryRaw.substringAfterLast("::").ifBlank{recommend}` = the main voice, so `kind`-based `pick` (648-655) is bypassed when speakerSlot > 0. This is a real, verified dead-code/logic bug: `presetVoice` is never null so `?: when (gender)` is unreachable. Worth reporting under #4/#5 (voice selection silently ignored → the user hears the same voice for every role).
- BooksReaderScreen:270-272 `runCatching` around `setVoice`, result ignored.
- TtsSettingsDialog:296-298 / OcrQueueScreen:642-643 shutdown in `runCatching`.
- TtsPluginBridge: **dead code**, no production references (only `TtsPluginBridgeTest.kt`); its `decide` only ever returns `VOICE`/`PLUGIN`/`VOICE_FALLBACK` and never touches TTS → cannot cause silence. Its package is `eu.kohesive.tachiyomi.data.tts` (legacy) while everything else is `eu.kanade.tachiyomi`.
- SpeakerGenderService (not read this session) — I should not claim. I'll leave it out or say it only feeds gender hints. Actually I haven't read it in this session; the earlier summary said "catches and returns null all". I'll mention only if I verify. Let me not include unverified claims. To be safe I'll mention it as "not a TTS path (feeds gender hints only)" — hmm, I should verify quickly. It's cheap.

**Empty-text paths**:
- `speakAs` 478-482: `SpeechMarkup.forSpeech(strip(text))` blank → silent return (after markFailure(NONE) at 475) → AutoReadEngine reports SILENT (1107). Intended.
- `speakWithVoice` 343-347: same, and it does NOT reset markFailure.
- `speakWithEdgeVoice` 443-448: same.
- `speakSystem` 719: `splitSentences(...)` empty → silent; 740: `units.isEmpty()` (a sentence of pure markup like `(*устал*)` where the state is already folded into the pitch/rate multiplier) → silent.
- `speakSystem` 778: `if (trimmed.isEmpty()) return@forEachIndexed` — a single empty chunk; if ALL are empty then `queued` stays false → REJECTED (825-828).
- `SpeechCue.deliveries` returns `emptyList()` for a blank sentence (SpeechCue.kt:340) and drops non-audible chunks (`isAudible` = has at least one letter/digit, 443-445), so a sentence made only of digits is dropped? No — digits are audible. A sentence of only `{1}{ж}` markup or only `(*шёпот*)` → nothing spoken.
- `AutoReadEngine` 943-... `speakSingle`/`readFrame` reject text that fails `SpeechMarkup`-strip / language heuristics (the check around 1001).
- `SpeechMarkup.strip` + `forSpeech` — service markup removed; if the text was only markup → empty.

**Probe/warm-up**:
- No audible warm-up utterance anywhere in `TtsSpeaker`. Probes are: (a) `systemVoiceSpecs` 281-286 (latch 3 s, blocking, IO dispatcher at the call site TtsVoicePickerDialog:60), (b) `installedEngines` 251-263, (c) `speakSystemVoiceTest` 840-885 (a real spoken test, but only for the settings "Проба" that goes through `speak`... actually `speakSystemVoiceTest` is not referenced anywhere? Let me check. grep showed no caller in TtsSettingsDialog for `speakSystemVoiceTest`! Let me verify — the grep for TtsSettingsDialog showed `speakSystemVoiceTest` at no line. Indeed, my grep of TtsSettingsDialog showed only `speakWithVoice` (481, 593), `TtsSpeaker.speak` (1190), `VoiceGrid`. So **`speakSystemVoiceTest` is dead code** — the "Проба" for the main voice calls `TtsSpeaker.speak()` instead, which is exactly the bug the doc comment at 834-839 claims to fix. That's a great finding: the function written to fix "all voices sound the same" is never called.
  Let me verify with a global grep.
- (d) `TtsSettingsDialog` 189-223 DisposableEffect probe (main-thread post, retry 247-251), 287-302 per-engine probe (6 s latch), `VoiceHelper.prepareForLanguage` 242; (e) `OcrQueueScreen` 620-660 (main-thread post, `prepareForLanguage` 653, retry loop 654-658).
- These probes warm the **list**, not playback. `ensureSystem` is the only playback init and it just queues callbacks (202-206). # Root cause (highest confidence)

`speakWithVoice()` parses a voice spec **without** the `::` guard that `speakSystem()` uses, so a bare local voice name is mistaken for a TTS **engine package**.

`app/src/main/java/eu/kanade/tachiyomi/data/tts/TtsSpeaker.kt:350-351`
```kotlin
val forcedPkg = voiceSpec.substringBefore("::").trim()   // "ru-ru-x-dfc-local"
val voiceName = voiceSpec.substringAfterLast("::").trim() // "ru-ru-x-dfc-local"
```

Kotlin's `substringBefore(delimiter)` returns **the original string** when the delimiter is absent, so `forcedPkg` becomes the voice *name*. Then:

- `TtsSpeaker.kt:361` — `forcedPkg.isNotBlank()` is true → `wantEdge = forcedPkg.startsWith("edge")` = false
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:374` — `ensureSystem(context, "ru-ru-x-dfc-local")`
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:149` — `wantEngine = "ru-ru-x-dfc-local"`
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:183` — `TextToSpeech(app, listener, "ru-ru-x-dfc-local")` → no such TTS service → `onInit(ERROR)`
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:170` → `onReady(null)`
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:375-378` — `setSpeaking(false)`; no toast, no log, no `markFailure`

**And it also destroys the working engine:** `TtsSpeaker.kt:150-156` shuts down the already-initialized `systemTts` because `systemEnginePkg != wantEngine`.

Contrast the correct version in the same file, `TtsSpeaker.kt:589-594`:
```kotlin
val forcedPkg = (
    roleVoice?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it.contains("::") }?.substringBefore("::")
    ?: primaryRaw.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it.contains("::") }?.substringBefore("::")
    ...
```

**Reachable from every UI action that plays a locally-listed voice by spec:**
| UI | Call chain |
|---|---|
| "Проба" of a role slot | `TtsSettingsDialog.kt:481-485` → `speakWithVoice` |
| "Проба" of a dictionary role | `TtsSettingsDialog.kt:593-597` → `speakWithVoice` |
| ♀ / ♂ / 🎙 on recognized text | `ReaderActivity.kt:1264` → `speakRole` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:414-419`) → `slotVoiceSpec` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:311-324`) → `speakWithVoice` |

| # | Producer | Line | Stored key | Format |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `TtsSpeaker.systemVoiceSpecs()` (quick picker) | `TtsSpeaker.kt:277-300`, esp. `:287, :293` | `"$pkg::$name"` | ✅ correct (unless `pkg == ""`) |
| B | `TtsSettingsDialog` grid, **active** engine | `TtsSettingsDialog.kt:274-279` (`key = voice.name`) | bare name | ❌ |
| C | `TtsSettingsDialog` grid, **other** engines | `TtsSettingsDialog.kt:306-313` | `"$pkg::$name"` | ✅ |

Producer A:
```kotlin
val pkg = runCatching { tts?.defaultEngine }.getOrNull().orEmpty()   // :287
specs += label to "${pkg}::${v.name}"                                // :293
```

Producers B and D store exactly what `android.speech.tts.Voice.name` is, with no engine identity — even though the probe instance *is* bound to a specific package (`TtsSettingsDialog.kt:207-211`, `OcrQueueScreen.kt:634-638`).

# 2. Which engine handles local/system playback

- `TtsSpeaker.speakAs()` (`:464-515`) → `VoicePlugins.resolveSpeakEngine()` (`VoicePlugins.kt:324-336`) → `speakSystem()` (`:558`) for `system_tts` / `auto`-offline / any `phoneOnly` case.
- `ensureSystem()` (`:148-208`) binds `TextToSpeech(app, listener, wantEngine)`; `wantEngine` = spec package, else `pref_system_tts_engine` (`:149`).
- `speakSystem()` voice choice: `VoiceHelper.pick` / `pickForSpeaker` (`:640-663`).
- `TtsVoicePickerDialog` spec path: `speakWithVoice()` (`:331`) → `ensureSystem()` or Edge TTS.

Engine-id constants themselves are consistent (`VoicePlugins.kt:152,171`, `TtsSpeaker.kt` `ENGINE_*`, `OcrPreferences.kt:119`); no naming mismatch there.

# 3. Where the engine id / package is lost or mismatched

1. **`speakWithVoice` bare-name → bogus package** (§Root cause). Primary.
2. **`systemVoiceSpecs` ignores `pref_system_tts_engine`** — it probes the **Android default** engine (`TtsSpeaker.kt:283`) and tags every voice with that package. If the user selected RHVoice (or any non-default engine), the "📱 Системные голоса (оффлайн)" list shows the *default* engine's voices, and the spec then forces playback back to the default engine (`:374` → `:150-156` shutdown).
3. **`pkg` can be empty** in producer A: the 3 s latch at `TtsSpeaker.kt:286` can expire, `defaultEngine` returns null → spec `"::ru-ru-…"` → `forcedPkg == ""` → `wantEdge` falls through to `:363-368`, and with `phoneOnly=false` + an online engine pref the heuristic `edgeName` (`:354-356`, `startsWith("ru-")`) routes a **local** voice into Edge TTS.
4. **Naive parser-only fix is unsafe:** even with `forcedPkg` correctly empty, `edgeName` (`:354-356`) still matches Google local names (`ru-ru-x-dfc-local`, `en-us-…`, `*Neural`), so `wantEdge` becomes true. Engine identity must be explicit, not inferred from the name.
5. **`speakerSlot > 0` discards the user's chosen voice.** With `pref_per_speaker_voices` defaulting to **true** (`OcrPreferences.kt:319`) and a detected gender, `AutoReadEngine.kt:739-748` → `voiceSlotFor` (`:137-151`) returns **1** for the first speaker, so `TtsSpeaker.kt:641` (`speakerSlot == 0`) fails and `:648-654` `pickForSpeaker` chooses an arbitrary voice from the group.
6. **Per-role engine prefs are never honored.** `VoiceModeResolver.resolve()` / `applyToTts()` have **no callers** (only `currentMode()`/`narratorGender()` are used, `AutoReadEngine.kt:706-710`); `speakAs` uses only the global `voiceEngine` (`:502`). `applyToTts` also hardcodes `"ru"` and passes `null` as the engine package. `resolve()` additionally classifies `ENGINE_REMOTE` as "local".
7. **Hardcoded `ru` breaks non-ru local voices.** `VoiceHelper.pick` → `pickFor(..., "ru", ...)` (`VoiceHelper.kt:292`); exact-name match is only tried against ru-filtered voices (`:301`). Non-ru picks (the grid shows all languages, `TtsSettingsDialog.kt:338-340`) fall through to another ru voice or to `engine.language = Locale("ru","RU")` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:697, 700`) → `speak()` ERROR → `REJECTED` (`:825-828`).
8. **`BooksReaderScreen` is a second, independent implementation** and drops the package: it stores `bookVoiceSpec` (`BooksReaderScreen.kt:252-279`) but always constructs `TextToSpeech(context)` = default engine (`:340-364, 409-428`) and ignores the `::` prefix; `setVoice` is wrapped in a `runCatching` whose result is never checked.
9. **Dead code that should have fixed this:** `speakSystemVoiceTest()` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:840-885`) exists precisely to "play the specific voice" — it has **zero callers**. The settings "Проба" calls `TtsSpeaker.speak()` (`TtsSettingsDialog.kt:1190`) instead, which is why every role/slot test can be silent while the main-voice test works.

# 5. Every path where the text ends up empty

- `TtsSpeaker.kt:478-482` (`speakAs`) — `SpeechMarkup.forSpeech(strip(text))` blank → silent return (after `markFailure(NONE)`).
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:343-347` (`speakWithVoice`) — same, and no `markFailure` reset.
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:443-448` (`speakWithEdgeVoice`) — same.
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:719` — `splitSentences()` empty → silent.
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:740` — `units.isEmpty()`: a sentence consisting only of markup (e.g. `(*устал*)`, whose state is already folded into pitch/rate) yields no `Delivery`.
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:778` — `if (trimmed.isEmpty()) return@forEachIndexed`; if all chunks are empty, `queued` stays false → `REJECTED` (`:825-828`).
- `SpeechCue.kt:340` — `deliveries()` returns `emptyList()` for a blank sentence; `isAudible` (`:443-445`) requires at least one letter **or digit**, so a chunk of pure punctuation/markup is dropped.
- `AutoReadEngine.kt:~1001` — blank / language-mismatched text rejected before `speak()` → `SILENT` (intended, logged at `:1017`).

# 6. Probe / warm-up

**There is no audible warm-up utterance anywhere.** Every probe warms only the *list*, never playback:

- `TtsSpeaker.kt:281-286` — `systemVoiceSpecs`: 3 s `CountDownLatch` (`ENGINE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS = 3000`, `:70`), blocking, called on IO (`TtsVoicePickerDialog.kt:60`).
- `TtsSpeaker.kt:251-263` — `installedEngines`: same latch, plus `PackageManager.queryIntentServices` (`:230-248`).
- `TtsSettingsDialog.kt:189-223` — `DisposableEffect` probe with main-queue post (`:200`, for OEM clients that call `OnInit` before the constructor returns); `:225-251` `prepareForLanguage` + 6 retries with increasing delay; `:294-302` per-engine probe with a 6 s latch.
- `OcrQueueScreen.kt:620-645` — same main-queue-post probe; `:646-660` `prepareForLanguage` + 6 retries.
- `TtsSpeaker.ensureSystem` (`:148-208`) is the only playback init and merely queues callbacks (`pendingReady`, capped at 8 at `:202`).

`LocalVoiceAdvisor.recommend` (`VoiceHelper.kt:385`) only reads a JSON rules file — no network, no TTS.

# Minimal fix (in order of impact)

1. **`TtsSpeaker.kt:350-351`** — make the parse symmetric with `speakSystem`:
   ```kotlin
   val sep = voiceSpec.indexOf("::")
   val forcedPkg = if (sep > 0) voiceSpec.substring(0, sep).trim() else ""
   val voiceName = if (sep > 0) voiceSpec.substring(sep + 2).trim() else voiceSpec.trim()
   ```
   and change `:361` / `:363-368` so `edgeName` is only consulted when the spec carries an explicit `edge::` prefix — never for a bare `ru-*`/`en-*`/`*Neural` name.
2. **`TtsSettingsDialog.kt:274-279` and `OcrQueueScreen.kt:687-691`** — store the package too, i.e. `key = "$pkg::${v.name}"` (producer A's format), so bare names no longer exist in prefs. Or better: store a typed record `{engine, name}` and stop encoding identity in a string.
3. **`TtsSpeaker.kt:379-403`** — add `markFailure(SpeakFailure.NONE)` at entry, check `engine.speak(...)`'s return, and route `onError` through `utteranceFailed` (`:539-543`), so failures surface as `REJECTED`/`NO_ENGINE` instead of `SILENT`.
4. **`TtsSpeaker.kt:697, 700` and `VoiceHelper.kt:292`** — use the voice's actual locale instead of the hardcoded `ru-RU` / `"ru"`.
5. **`TtsSpeaker.kt:641`** — honor the explicit user voice when `presetVoice`/`primaryRaw` is set, even for `speakerSlot > 0`.
6. Wire `speakSystemVoiceTest` (`TtsSpeaker.kt:840`) into the "Проба" buttons (`TtsSettingsDialog.kt:1190`) or delete it.
7. `BooksReaderScreen.kt:252-279, 340-364, 409-428` — parse and honor the `::` package, and check `setVoice`'s result.
